projects.ds: Build hefty coolers for larger walk-in freezers and demanding temperature control.
Build hefty heaters for large rooms and demanding temperature control.
Build solar powered heating for hot water tanks and radiators.

Build an agile combat mechanoid with a bizarre frame resembling a floating human torso. Relying on a built-in hoverjet instead of legs for locomotion, the skirmisher levitates above ground, safe from traps and unhindered by terrain difficulties. When in danger, it can quickly reposition to a safe distance with a burst from its jets.

Build a fast, insectile combat mechanoid designed to wreak havoc in close quarters. The ripper's bladed forelegs hide injector needles, dosing its target with mechanite-derived toxin with every slash. The toxin, beyond slowly dissolving the victim, uses their body as a mech gestator - creating mechanoid reinforcements on-site at the expense of its unfortunate foes.

Build a small combat support mechanoid armed with a mini-blaster sidearm. Fragile and diminutive, aides are unsuited for the frontline, designed to instead support more capable combat units from the back. Their pattern's sophisticated subcore allows them to merge systems with another mechanoid, enhancing their processing power, and increasing their resilience by acting as a backup for critical subsystems. However, should the merge end prematurely by aide's death, any unit it was connected to will suffer from severe system disruption, reducing their capacity to process data for a while.

Build a heavy combat mechanoid specialised in close-quarters engagements. The berserker's imposing frame is designed to draw enemy fire on approach, with every received hit enhancing its speed and strength of its stunning blows. The Rage Drive's improvements do not come without risk - at high intensity levels, it can overload critical subsystems, causing berserk-inducing malfunctions.

Build a clunky, ultra-heavy combat mechanoid designed as an artillery platform. Carrying a charge howitzer turret on its back, the bombardier acts as a siegebreaker, raining fire upon enemy emplacements on approach. Its cumbersome frame and unusually thin armor make it vulnerable in close-quarters combat.

Build a combat mechanoid vaguely resembling a cross between human and snake. The constrictor is designed to pick off priority targets on the field of battle, pulling them from behind cover with its grappling “tongue”, before crushing them with its powerful tail. Exceedingly effective against organics thanks to their hardware and toxic weaponry, constrictors are favoured by rogue mechives as a means of crushing human resistance.

Build a tall, spindly assassin mechanoid. The infiltrator's flexible carapace and telescopic limbs let it assume any stature it desires - and when covered in a biomimetic disguise, convincingly imitate human likeness. Employed by mechanitors and rogue swarms as covert operatives, infiltrators use their advanced optical cloaking to scout enemy positions, gather intel, and assassinate high-value targets using toxin-coated concealed weapons. Additionally, the disguise serves as a layer of ablative armor - under most circumstances, destroying it will not damage the mechanoid hidden within.\n\nEven when hiding behind a human facade, the infiltrator is still a mechanoid by nature - it remains vulnerable to EMP, and being an unfeeling machine, is unable to form relationships. When disguised, it will periodically relay data to its overseer, which can be intercepted by a savvy colony to find it out.

Build a heavy infantry mechanoid designed to excel in both close-quarters and ranged combat. The templar's Zeal Drive continuously improves its combat performance the longer it remains on the field of battle. Its heavy armor and armaments guarantee staying power during prolonged engagements.

Manufacture a mechlink upgrade which allows the mechanitor to interface with a mechanoid to boost its performance and reduce incoming damage. The user psychically links with their target, using their own brain as a backup for critical subsystems.

This implant can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to boost its range, reduce cooldown and increase the number of ability charges.

Build a human-sized mechanoid designed to take care of babies. Their upper body is covered in warm heating apparatuses to comfort newborns, and its chest simulates a human heartbeat. The Surrogate can feed children with baby food, play with them and fight fires. It can attack with a small slugthrower in case of an emergency.
Build a small mechanoid designed for working restaurants and hauling. It is slow. Lacking a ranged weapon, it can make only weak melee attacks.
Build a heavy hauling mechanoid with an armored cargo bay, road-ready locomotion, and hydraulic claws for shoving through work hazards or holding its ground in a fight.

Build a small specialist combat mechanoid armed with a high-power electromagnetic weapon and quick-charging shields. Scramblers are most effective against targets vulnerable to electromagnetic interference.
Build a small specialist worker mechanoid designed for hunting. Its stealthy frame and animal-targeting systems let it hunt wild animals, slaughter marked livestock, and lead animals to pens.
Build a medium-sized sonic warfare mechanoid that disrupts enemy formations with a terrible white-noise shriek.
Build a slow, heavily armored bunker-buster mechanoid armed with devastating explosive weaponry.
Build short-range urban warfare mechanoids, including both enforcer assaulters and enforcer breachers.
Build a conqueror mechanoid armed with a powerful charge blaster. Conquerors link their systems with nearby allied conquerors, improving their effectiveness in groups.
Build a conqueror mechanoid armed with a highly powered charge carbine. Conquerors link their systems with nearby allied conquerors, improving their effectiveness in groups.
Build a mobile cryogenic chamber mechanoid that stores, freezes, and dispenses organic material. It can also seal a targeted pawn inside itself for later use.
Build a reinforced fixed laser emplacement around a salvaged gazer ocular emitter. When manually aimed within its frontal firing arc, it releases a devastating sun ray beam at extreme power cost.
Build a toxic area-denial mechanoid that can pump tox gas into the area around it. Its melee attacks inflict toxic buildup on targets.
Build a plasma-whip mechanoid designed to handle, tame, and train animals. Its whip also functions in short-range combat, damaging and electrifying nearby targets.
Build an urban warfare mechanoid designed to breach structures and blind nearby enemies with intense impulse discharges. An installed jump pack lets it quickly move to its next target.
Build a support mechanoid that repairs same-faction buildings and mechanoids. It cannot construct new structures, but can shield allies and blind enemies with a targeted laser.
Build a coordination mechanoid that boosts nearby allies and extends mechanitor command range. Player-controlled vassals can also interface with local comms systems to improve allied morale.
Build a conqueror mechanoid armed with a powerful charge spitter. Conquerors link their systems with nearby allied conquerors, improving their effectiveness in groups.
Build a pollution reclaimer that cleans pollution from a large area and vaporizes toxic wastepacks. Its drastic operation can cause severe ecological side effects.
Build a facility that increases the gestation speed of adjacent mech gestators.
Build a powered station that repairs small and medium mechanoids. The mechanoid enters the station to undergo repairs.
Build a specialized stasis chamber that stores mechanoids in suspended animation. Stored mechs consume no power and do not occupy mechanitor bandwidth.
Manufacture a plasma whip inspired by the Lasher mechanoid's weapon. It can damage and stun multiple targets at once, making it useful for holding back enemies at close range.
Build a powered station that repairs large mechanoids. The mechanoid enters the station to undergo repairs.
Build a mighty defensive mechanoid that sacrifices offensive capability for mastery of protection through its dual shields.
Build a swift archotech commander mechanoid that can blink across short distances and create smokescreens that hide it from enemy perception.
Build an archotech commander mechanoid that empowers nearby allies and challenges perceived threats in psychic duels.
Manufacture a dominion psy-spear, a psionic weapon derived from Dominus control matrices.
Build a mechanoid powered by an oversized internal reactor. It can anchor itself to a power grid and act as a mobile shield generator.
Build a heavy ocular-beam mechanoid that locks itself in place to fire a devastating sun ray and can discharge shockwaves at close range.
Build a battlefield scavenger mechanoid that finishes off survivors and refines organic material, including corpses, into chemfuel within its chassis.
Build a mobile missile-launcher mechanoid with switchable warheads, including armor-piercing, incendiary, high-explosive, and EMP rockets.
Build a blade-armed assault mechanoid that lunges into close combat and executes brutal slashing attacks.
Build a heavily armored mechanoid designed to crush infantry, light vehicles, and outer defenses while overclocking its weapon under fire.
Build a heavy artillery mechanoid that can overcharge its weapon to launch devastating starfall barrages.
Build an archotech commander mechanoid that cleaves through groups, overdrives its combat systems, and drags distant enemies into reach with a grappling hook.
Manufacture a heavy combat blade integrated with Terminus-derived control matrices, allowing the wielder to channel sweeping psychic strikes.
Manufacture a reinforced gamma-ray emitter that produces a dense, destructive energy ball which discharges into nearby targets and ignites its surroundings.
Build a psychic mechanoid that lures colonists toward itself. When controlled by a mechanitor, it can provide a mood and recreation boost to nearby allies.
Manufacture a skipblade, a compact psyflux weapon derived from Celerus displacement technology.
Manufacture a mechmancer suit and matching helmet, power-assisted mechanitor armor that greatly expands bandwidth while providing serious protection.
Manufacture a mechmancer pack, an advanced bandwidth-expansion utility pack that can deploy independent satellite mechanoids.

Build a variation of the militor and bellicor, the artilleron stands at a height of around 5 feet and it is armed with a powerful mortar that fires explosive canisters with great accuracy. With its reduced durability, the Artilleron can't withstand intense battles and is often deployed in the rear lines to eliminate high priority targets and secure strategic objectives from afar. It can also swap weapons between its mortar and a low damage, high accuracy micro needle gun to avoid causing friendly fire with its explosives.

Build an advanced combat mechanoid designed to excel in high-risk combat situations. With a height of around 5 feet, it is armed with a rapid-firing tactical mechanoid shotgun. Unlike its predecessor, the Militor, the Bellicor is highly durable and has the ability to withstand intense battles. It is often deployed in the front lines to eliminate high priority targets and secure strategic objectives. Due to its advanced capabilities, the Bellicor is more expensive to produce and maintain, but is still highly valued by those who seek to dominate the battlefield.

Build a unique mechanoid designed for tactical warfare and area denial. Shaped like a sleek and menacing metallic mine, it is capable of self-propelling itself to the intended target location before detonating in a devastating explosion. However, its indiscriminate detonation makes it a double-edged sword, and careful coordination is required to ensure that it does not harm friendly forces.

Build a mechanoid designed for culinary arts, that can analyze ingredients and create delicious meals with exceptional precision and consistency. The Culinarius can access an extensive database of recipes, culinary techniques, and flavor profiles, allowing it to adapt and customize its cooking style to suit any cuisine or dietary requirement. Its sturdy metal frame and robust construction make it resistant to heat, moisture, and other common hazards in the kitchen. Much better at cooking than a fabricor, but very inefficient in combat.

Build what is essentially a cleansweeper mounted on two small gyro-stabilized turbine engines. The turbocleaner hovers over terrain, using a vacuum nozzle to suction dirt and other debris. Absurdly useless in combat.

Build an angel-shaped mechanoid surrounded by a whirling cloud of six levitating metallic blades. They favour close combat, approaching their victims and engulfing them in an eviscerating whirlwind of slashing death. They also have the ability to regenerate their wounds with fast acting mechanites.

Build a sleek and agile humanoid mechanoid designed for fast-paced combat operations. Equipped with a powerful heavy laser weapon, it is capable of dealing devastating damage to both ground and air targets with pinpoint accuracy. The Lux's agility comes at the cost of durability, and it must rely on its speed and evasion to survive on the battlefield.

Build a formidable human-sized combat mechanoid designed specifically for long-range combat scenarios. They are equipped with advanced coil lances, which are mass driver weapons that fire electromagnetically accelerated slugs at incredible velocities. These projectiles are capable of penetrating through almost any kind of defense, including thick armor plating and reinforced concrete.

Build an elite combat support mechanoid that employs a rotary needle launcher. Its armor is reinforced to withstand heavy firepower, and it can project a formidable energy shield to protect nearby allies. The Optio is a valuable asset on the battlefield, able to quickly adapt to changing situations and provide crucial support to other mechanoids.

Build a heavy combat mechanoid with a graser cannon that can deal massive damage to armored targets. Though it lacks agility, its graser cannon is capable of firing focused energy beams that can cut through most shielding and leave enemies defenseless.
Build pristine versions of ancient biomechs.

Build a mechanoid that looks like a weird amalgamation of a deep sea crab, a star-nosed mole and an armoured combat vehicle. Demolishers are armed with a very dangerous short range turret that fires demolisher charges, capable of blowing up even the strongest walls in two or three hits. Once they have ruptured a colony's outer defenses, their enormous plasteel reinforced claws can make short work of anyone foolish enough to stay in their way.

Build a huge mechanical worm armed with a dangerous chemfuel flamethrower. Their weapon has a very short range, so don't let a fireworm approach your defenses!\n\nThe fireworm superficially resembles a Frostbound Behemoth. A coincidence? Or perhaps mechanoids take living things as a blueprint for their units. If so, you wouldn't want to see what a biological scyther looks like.

Build a hulking mechanoid based on a rhinoceros beetle body plan. The phalanx's plasteel carapace hides a very powerful cryogenic engine capable of constantly producing compacted pellets of supercooled gas. These are fired from an aperture at the mechanoid's head.

This cryo-weapon has a very low range, but it can be very dangerous for beings susceptible to frostbite.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Will explode on death with 10 Frostbite damage on a 2.9 tile radius.

If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Pikeman.
Build a remote energy efficiency enhancement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will use less energy per day.
Build a remote armor reinforcement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will have greater protection against attacks.
Build a remote targeting enhancement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will have reduced weapon cooldown.

Build a remote energy and computation enhancement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will move and work faster. This boost will be overwritten if the mech enters the range of a standard mech booster. The effect of the persistent mech booster will remain on the mech up to 3 hours after leaving its area of effect.
Build a remote mech disruption device. Any enemy mechanoids in its effect radius will have reduced agility, movement and targeting skill.
Manufacture a heavy power armor helmet packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mech master helmet drastically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, while being as protective as a marine helmet.
Build a remote mech disruption device. Any enemy mechanoids in its effect radius will have reduced agility, movement and targeting skill.

Manufacture a backpack containing a voidlink relay to access the vast amounts of data present on this system's mechanoid voidlink network. It can vastly increase a mechanitor's maximum total bandwidth.

Build a hulking mechanoid based on a rhinoceros beetle body plan. The phalanx's plasteel carapace hides a very powerful cryogenic engine capable of constantly producing compacted pellets of supercooled gas. These are fired from an aperture at the mechanoid's head.\n\nThis cryo-weapon has a very low range, but it can be very dangerous for beings susceptible to frostbite.

Build a hulking mechanoid based on a rhinoceros beetle body plan. The phalanx's plasteel carapace hides a very powerful cryogenic engine capable of constantly producing compacted pellets of supercooled gas. These are fired from an aperture at the mechanoid's head.\n\nThis cryo-weapon has a very low range, but it can be very dangerous for beings susceptible to frostbite.

Build a variant of the siegebreaker armed with a powerful flamethrower. Their movement is incredibly slow, but their siegemelter turret has a considerable range, so they should be treated as priority targets in most cases.
Design and build a drone is equipped with a small megaphone. It is useful for boosting morale among colonists, or deploying propaganda against different ways of thinking or prisoners.
Design and build a combat-oriented drone for military use. The drone is equipped with a small stubgun, making it a decent opponent on the battlefield.
Design and build a treaded drone for hauling and transportation tasks. The drone is equipped with small prongs, making it proficient in moving items around.
Design and build a specialized drone for mining operations. The drone is equipped with a small drill, making it proficient in extracting resources.
Design and build a specialized drone for defensive operations. The drone is equipped with a small turret, designed to provide stationary fire support while being able to be moved if necessary.
Build a small mechanoid designed to clean the colony.
Build a small mechanoid designed to sow and harvest crops.
Manufacture a head-mounted comms computer that slightly enhances a mechanitor's control bandwidth, allowing them to control more mechs.
Build a signal amplifying structure that grants an additional bandwidth to a mechanitor, allowing them to control more mechs.
Manufacture a backpack containing mech control computers, allowing its mechanitor to control one additional group.
Build a small mechanoid equipped with a mini-shotgun, designed for combat and defense.

Manufacture a neural implant which gives a mechanitor an additional control group. Additionally, the sublink slightly increases the work speed of any mechanoids controlled by the mechanitor.

This standard-tier sublink can only increase the control group count up to 3. To go higher, a higher-tier sublink implant must be used.

It can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its effect.

Manufacture a neural implant which gives a mechanitor an additional control group. Additionally, the sublink slightly increases the work speed of any mechanoids controlled by the mechanitor.

This high-tier implant can increase the control group count up to 6.

It can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its effect.
Manufacture a head-mounted signal array computer that greatly enhances a mechanitor's control bandwidth, allowing them to control significantly more mechs.
Manufacture a backpack containing bandwidth enhancement devices, allowing its mechanitor to control one additional group.

Produce a front-line combat mechanoid named for its large optical array. The cyclops specializes in counter-shield attacks. It takes a long time to lock onto a target, but once locked on, it fires a near endless barrage of shield-piercing beams.

Manufacture an implant which increases the speed at which a mechanitor can produce mechs in a mech gestator. The processor optimizes the behavior of the mechanites in the mech forming tank.

This implant can be self-installed in the same way as the mechlink.

This implant can be installed up to 6 times to increase its effect.

Manufacture a plasteel-weave combat helmet designed for battle mechanitors. It is embedded with computers and signal enhancers that moderately increase the wearer's maximum control bandwidth. This allows the mechanitor to control more mechs.
Produce a clunky multi-legged combat mechanoid specialized as a long-range weapons platform. While effective at distance, it is weak in close-range fights and in melee combat.

Produce a close-approach war mechanoid that specializes in incendiary attacks. Its flame burst attack has little reach, but once it closes on a group of defenders it can ignite and disrupt them with blasts of searing flame.
Produce a heavy mechanoid built for mining in treacherous locations. While intended for excavation, the tunneler's gigantic power claws and ultra-thick armor makes it a dangerous force in combat.

Produce heavy combat mechanoids that glide on dozens of tiny legs. Their thick carapace and firepower makes them very effective against bunched-up static defenders. They are somewhat vulnerable to mobile hit-and-run tactics.

Produce an ultra-heavy mechanoid with an ultra-powerful hellsphere cannon. Made for siegebreaking, its hellsphere cannon takes time to charge up a shot, but can melt concrete and vaporize bone. The diabolus dissipates the hellsphere cannon's waste power in a heat column mounted on its back, which can pulse to ignite flammable objects nearby.
Produce a small work mechanoid designed to craft all manner of manufactured objects.
Produce an advanced head-mounted computer and signaling array that dramatically enhances a mechanitor's control bandwidth. This allows the wearer to control many more mechanoids at once.
Build a remote energy and computation enhancement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will move and work faster.

Build a small mechanoid designed for non-violent emergency situation management and medical care. The paramedic can rescue the wounded, fight fires, treat the sick, and even perform surgery when a more-qualified human is not available. Its built-in jump launcher allows it to jump into, and out of, emergency situations, and its built-in firefoam popper can quickly extinguish fires.

Manufacture a mechlink upgrade which allows the mechanitor to repair mechs from a distance. The user links with the mechanoid and uses their own brain to psychically guide its self-repair mechanites.

This implant can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its range.

Manufacture an implant which allows the mechanitor to place a personal defense shield on a mech. The mechanitor must continuously focus on the mech in order to maintain the shield.

Placing a shield at a distance requires a substantial amount of focused energy. It can be used to save a mech at a critical moment.

This implant can be self-installed in the same way as the mechlink.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its range and shield energy.

Manufacture a power-assisted armor suit packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mechlord suit dramatically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, but is somewhat less protective than dedicated heavy armor.

Manufacture an implant which increases the speed at which a mechanitor can repair a mechanoid. This does not affect the overall energy needed to repair a mechanoid.

The implant allows the mechanitor to plug directly into a mechanoid while they are repairing it. This allows them to more quickly understand the mech's injuries, and better-direct the mech's self-repair mechanites to assist with the repair.

This implant can be self-installed in the same way as the mechlink.

This implant can be installed up to 6 times to increase its effect.

Build an ultra-heavy mech with a built-in mech gestator. Fed with appropriate resources, the war queen can form small war urchin combat mechs within its massive carapace and deploy them into combat.\n\nEven more than other mechanoids, the war queen resembles a giant, living insect. All war mechs can be terrifying, but humans tend to find the war queen disturbing on a deeper level.
Build a combat support mechanoid with a wide-range bullet shield and mid-range needle gun. Designed to support other mechanoids, the legionary is vulnerable to anyone who can get inside its shield.
Build a smaller combat construct that carries an experimental miniaturized version of the lightning gun seen in bigger constructs.

Build a heavy combat mechanoid that glides on dozens of tiny legs. Their thick carapace and firepower makes them very effective against bunched-up static defenders. They are somewhat vulnerable to mobile hit-and-run tactics.
Build an extinguisher drone trap that launches a firefoam drone when it detects nearby flames.
Build a trap that releases paralytic wasp drones.
Build a hunter trap that releases toxic gas on detonation.
Build a hunter trap armed with an antigrain warhead.
Build a hunter trap that ignites the area on detonation.
Build a hunter trap that disables electronics on detonation.
Build a hunter trap that releases obscuring smoke on detonation.
Build a wearable pack that deploys a toxic hunter drone.
Build a wearable pack that deploys an antigrain hunter drone.
Build a wearable pack that deploys an incendiary hunter drone.
Build a wearable pack that deploys an EMP hunter drone.
Build a wearable pack that deploys a smoke hunter drone.
Build a wearable pack that deploys a hunter drone.

projects.ds: Manage resources and traversal of platform vehicles.
Build various improvement modules to vehicle platforms.

Build a self-contained mobile dwelling, designed for a portable life on the rim. Can be entered like a structure, offering a compact interior with space to rest, store supplies, and shelter from the elements. Though cramped it provides a novel luxury, a home that moves with you. Ideal for a nomadic lifestyle.

Build a basic automobile with good speed and decent cargo capacity, but can only transport a couple people. It consumes quite a bit of fuel and performs better in smooth asphalt than difficult terrain.
Build an all-purpose car with good passenger and cargo capacity, high fuel efficiency, and lower visibility, but it will struggle to move on hills, snow or winter tiles..

Build a lightly armored car, intended to provide mobile fire support. Its armor is effective against small arms, but is vulnerable in the rear. It can carry three people along paved roads, but is less fuel-efficient on the world map.
Build a small motorcycle for a single passenger. It can move through long distances in any terrain, but can't carry cargo. Be careful to not run out of fuel if you want to go too far.
Build a light tank fitted with thin, fireproof plating and chemfuel tanks to burn enemies and fortifications with its flamethrower. It's not very fuel-efficient in the world map.
Build a farm tractor repurposed to carry a rack of explosive rockets. Its fuel usage is high and it has very little armor, but it can easily barrage your enemies from a distance.
Build a transport pod fitted with many thrusters, allowing for repeated use after landing in its destination. Moves much faster than a regular transport pod, but consumes a lot of fuel.
Build a heavily-armored rocket pod with a siege gun mounted on top, uses a lot of fuel to move but functions essentially as a deployable bunker from where to besiege your enemies.
Build a small motorized boat. Has good cargo capacity, but uses a lot of fuel. It's not made to sail through winter or river currents, and the motor in the back is vulnerable to gunshots.
Build a basic truck intended to transport high amounts of cargo at long distances on paved roads. It's less efficient for short trips, and will have trouble moving through frozen or steep terrain.
Build a small van, intended to transport people on paved roads. Has low cargo capacity but high passenger space, and can consume a lot of fuel in long travels.
Build a large van with very high passenger capacity, great fuel efficiency and lower visibility. However, it will struggle a lot in hills, snow and winter.
Build a fast-moving plane with minimal cargo capacity, intended to engage other aircraft in battle. It has regular fuel efficiency, and is very easy to notice.

Build a small helicopter that moves extremely fast and can carry more cargo than an off-roader, but requires a landing pad. It is very visible, like any aircraft. It has a regular fuel efficiency on the world map, but makes up for it in speed.
Build an armed vehicle with hardened armor, good cargo capacity and all-terrain support. However, it's slow, very visible, and not very fuel-efficient, and has a slightly lower defense on the rear.
Build a large truck meant to deliver troops and supplies away from the base. It can move well in rough terrain, but the fuel efficiency is low, and passengers in the back will lack protection.
Build a vessel with high cargo capacity and good fuel efficiency. It has low visibility, but will have trouble moving on rivers or during winter.

Build a motorcycle that can quickly and discretely transport a single person and a small amount of cargo. Has a good fuel efficiency in the world map, and can move well in any terrain except snow, or during winter.

Build a small tank with light armor. It's very cheap and easy to assemble, but very loud and vulnerable in the rear. They aren't very fast or accurate and use a lot of fuel, and are best used in short-range engagements.
Build a light utility jeep for scouting and transporting a small crew over rough terrain.

Build a heavy-duty truck with a vast building platform on its bed, perfect for mounting weapons or transporting large amounts of equipment or other vehicles. It has excellent cargo capacity but is less fuel-efficient.
Build a behemoth moving platform, capable of sustaining a entire civilization on its surface.
Build a slow vehicle designed to traverse snow and winter terrain without trouble. Its engine makes a lot of noise.

Manufacture a chest-mounted reservoir and subdermal injector that stores up to five units of one drug or hemogen packs, allowing the wearer to administer a stored dose on demand. Its reinforced casing also provides a small amount of armor.

Manufacture an advanced artificial ear implant. A collection of invisible subdermal microphones capture sound and transmit it to a biogel nerve interface that links directly with the auditory nerve. It's sensitive enough to hear a cat before you see it, can't be damaged by loud noise, and automatically tunes itself to pick out meaningful sounds in noisy environments.

Manufacture an advanced artificial eye. With its biogel nerve-link, internal signal pre-processor, and wide-spectrum sensors, it is better than a biological eye in almost every way. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage.
Manufacture an artificial jaw replacement. Made out of biosynthetic bone, with plasteel tooth replacements and a set of micro servomotors for the full range of motion.
Manufacture an advanced artificial leg. With its biogel nerve-link, powerful mini-servos, and lattice-dust healing system, it is better than a biological leg in almost every way.
Manufacture an advanced artificial spine. A biogel nerve bundle runs down an articulated plasteel core, surrounded by a lattice-dust healing system. It matches the performance of a biological spine.

Manufacture an artificial digestive organ with sensors and chemical synthesizers that process nearly any energy-bearing food. A lattice-dust repair system heals damage caused by its powerful acids, allowing performance beyond a biological organ.

Manufacture an artificial tongue replacement. Made of synthetic smooth-fibers and connected through a neurogel interface, it can match the performance of a natural tongue in speaking, eating, and tasting.

Manufacture an implant which replaces normal hearing. An external microphone transmits a sound signal to electrodes wrapped around the inner ear's auditory sensing nerves. The electrodes stimulate the nerves according to the sound, creating a sensation of hearing. It's not as good as a natural ear, but it's a lot better than being deaf.

Manufacture a brain implant that stimulates the brain's pleasure centers. While it dramatically improves a user's mood, the blanket of happiness makes it hard to concentrate on anything real. implants are illegal on many worlds, and are known for destroying whole cultures.

Manufacture a leg prosthesis. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real leg.

Manufacture a set of nanoelectrodes and antennas which can be used by any sentient biological being to open clearance-locked doors remotely. Clearance level is programmed onto the set during installation, and cannot be changed until it is removed.

For humanlike pawns with natural arms, a hand-implanted version can be used instead.

Manufacture a hand-implantable microchip that can act as a security keycard. Clearance level is programmed onto the chip during installation, and cannot be changed until it is removed.

Pawns with bionic arms and animals can use the brain interface version instead.
Manufacture an anima golem module that increases the manipulative ability of golems, at the cost of a lowered locomotor coordination.

Manufacture an implanted implant, designed to cover the user in firefoam when necessary. The device automatically activates if the user catches fire.

Manufacture an advanced artificial tail. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while a biogel nerve-extension on the Coccyx gives exquisit control. It's extended support structures and enhanced mini-servos give the user unrivaled versatility when it comes to carying and moving objects.

Manufacture a miniature electrical emitter installed at the base of the brainstem, designed to emit an incapacitating series of electrical pulses.

Manufacture a neural implant capable of simulating audio-visual stimuli. Picks up transmissions from ancient satelites and ubiquitous data cards.

projects.ds:
Manufacture a bioferrite power claw that can be surgically installed on a ghoul, granting it a powerful attack. Each of the nerve shredder's jagged digits contain a resevoir of deadlife dust filled fluid that, while not inherently harmful, will raise anyone killed with it as a shambler allied to the ghoul. These clawed hands are harder to hold things with.

Due to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.

Manufacture a bulky, miniaturised bioferrite harvester that can be surgically installed on a ghoul. A series of tubes implanted throughout the body slowly drain excess biomass to be converted into bioferrite. This consumption of bioferrite increases the ghoul's appetite.

Due to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.

Manufacture a bioferrite combustion engine that can be surgically installed in a ghoul, increasing it's speed. The engine burns a portion of the ghoul's naturally generated bioferrite to increase it's movement and attack speed. This consumption of bioferrite drastically increases the ghoul's appetite.

Due to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.

Manufacture an implant that attunes its user to the monolith. The implant uses dark archotechnology to allow its user to hear the whispers of the void. The greater the void's link to reality, the greater the user's psychic sensitivity and madness grows.

Manufacture a bioferrite power claw that can be surgically installed on a ghoul, granting it a powerful, paralytic attack. Each of the nerve shredder's jagged digits contain a resevoir of paralytic biotoxin. These clawed hands are harder to hold things with.

Due to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.

Manufacture a bioferrite helmet fitted with advanced optics that can be surgically attached to a ghoul, improving it's vision and protecting it's head. This irremovable helmet performs complex combat calculations and utilises a brute force biogel nerve-link to influence it's user's movements. Some find it's lifeless mechanical lense less unsettling that the twisted, ghoulified face of someone they once knew.

Due to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.

Manufacture an implant that attunes its user to rip the psychic energies from slain foes. The implant uses dark archotechnology to harvest psyfocus from death, allowing its user to repurpose this energy, if they are capable.

projects.ds: Manufacture an implant that supplies sanguine chemicals and specialized mechanites to slow the deterioration of deathrest benefits. Installation requires the deathrest gene.

Manufacture a pair of retractable, spring-loaded plasteel canines, connected to a vaccum pump. The user can bite an enemy, extend the fangs, and suck the blood from the target, converting it directly into a moderate amount of hemogen.

Can only be installed on pawns with the hemogenic gene.

Manufacture an advanced biorefinery that folds and compresses hemogen into a denser state, allowing a sangophage to store more within their body.

Can only be installed on pawns with the hemogenic gene.

Manufacture a miniaturised, implanted mechanoid gestator that allows the mechanitor to produce reinforcements in the field, without infrastructure or complex components.

This implant can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 6 times to increase its capacity.

Manufacture an implant which allows the mechanitor to psychically attack and override a mechs IFF protocol, taking them under their control, provided the mechanoid is susceptible to psychic attack and the mechanitor has sufficient bandwidth.

This implant can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its range.

Manufacture an implant which allows the mechanitor to externally supercharging a recently-killed, allied mechanoid's self-repair processes, provided they have enough bandwidth to take that mech under their control. The mechanoid will come back with some but not all of its wounds healed.

This implant can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its range.

Manufacture a neural implant which increases the signal radius of the mechanitor by 3 tiles.

This standard-tier signal booster can only increase the radius by up to 9. To go higher, a higher-tier signal booster implant must be used.

It can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its effect.

Manufacture a neural implant which increases the signal radius of the mechanitor by 3 tiles.

This standard-tier signal booster can only increase the radius by up to 18. To go higher, a higher-tier signal booster implant must be used.

It can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its effect.

Manufacture a neural implant which increases the signal radius of the mechanitor by 3 tiles.

This standard-tier signal booster can only increase the radius by up to 27.

It can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its effect.

Manufacture an advanced artificial womb. It can monitor and optimise nutrient level and apply growth stimulators to improve gestation speed, it's articulated construction allows for safer labor and it has a mechanite based sperm sorting system to enhance fertility. It is better than a biological womb in almost every way.

Manufacture a neural implant which allows for the uploading of specialised tactical protocols to any mechanoids controlled by the mechanitor. The bonuses granted to mechs melee and ranged abilities further scale with the mechanitor's own intellectual skill.

It can be self-installed without surgery.

This implant can be installed up to 3 times to increase its effect.

Manufacture an interlink node scavenged from the cerebrex core of a mechhive. It can be used to summon mechanoids or mechanoid transport pods from the planet-wide mechanoid satellite network.

This implant is self-installable but since it interlaces deep within the brain tissue, it can only be removed after death.

The device can be activated while the pawn is down, though it can only hold a limited number of charges and will need refueling with chemfuel between uses.

projects.ds:
Manufacture a suit of subdermally installed, lightly powered armour, formed of thin, semi-flexible plasteel plates and substituted by hyperweave where higher degrees of movement are necessary. Slim neuro-memetic assistors allow the user to move naturally.

Expensive and beauty accentuating, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.

Manufacture an advanced artificial tail. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while a biogel nerve-extension spliced into the tailbone gives exquisit control. The user can stab the stinger into their enemies and inject venom into the wound.
Manufacture a device of incredibly complex and esoteric construction, able to safely absorb and normalise chaotic psychic energies.
Manufacture a miniature, retractable charge turret implanted on the shoulder. It's AI allows it to autonomously fire, even on the move, though it's size limits it's effectiveness.
Manufacture a neural interface that connects a gunner's brain directly to a weapon system, enhancing the gunners's control and accuracy.
Manufacture a high-tech, advanced model of coagulator incorperating embedded cryptocasket technology that uses a stasis effect in response to blood loss to slow one's bleeding.

Manufacture an implanted gland that uses chemicals and nanomachines to form thermoregulating structures across the skin. The resulting insulating sheath prevents frostbite and greatly improves resistance to extreme temperatures.

Manufacture a special bioferrite prosthetic that allows a ghoul to saturate its bloodstream with stress hormones and liquid energy. The ghoul will move and attack at incredible speeds for a short amount of time. The prosthetic slightly increases the ghoul's metabolism, causing it to eat more.

Due to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.

Manufacture a special bioferrite prosthetic that allows the ghoul to spray a corrosive fluid. The prosthetic repurposes a chamber of the ghoul's heart to create a strong acid, which can be projected from the ghoul's mouth.

Due to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.

Manufacture bioferrite armor plates for surgical attachment over vulnerable areas. They significantly reduce incoming damage but slow movement. Only ghouls can tolerate the installation's extreme pain.

Manufacture a special bioferrite prosthetic that can pump a small amount of metalblood into a ghoul's bloodstream, making it more resistant to damage for a short period of time. Metalblood also makes the ghoul more vulnerable to fire. The prosthetic causes widespread swelling, slowing the ghoul down.

Due to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.

Manufacture a prosthetic spine that allows the user to temporarily become invisible. The prosthetic is crafted from a modified revenant spine and uses archotech shards to restrain the dormant revenant. The user can manipulate the visual centers of those nearby, effectively turning themself invisible for a short time.

Manufacture an advanced artificial lung that uses microfilters to reduce the intake of environmental toxins, allowing the user to survive longer in polluted environments. Additionally, it negates the irritation of acidic smog and prevents lung rot in this lung.
Manufacture a neural interface that connects a pilot's brain directly to a vehicle, enhancing the pilot's control and reaction speed. Just don't think about crashing.

Manufacture a special bioferrite prosthetic that actively heats a ghoul's blood, allowing it to survive in cold environments. The prosthetic replaces a ghoul's kidney, heating the blood as it passes through.

Due to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.
Manufacture an implanted gland that coats the skin in an insulating wax to prevent vacuum burns. It also regulates blood oxygen to extend survival in space, although the coating restricts movement.

Manufacture a sophisticated package of hormonal and mechanite influences shapes the muscles and fat on the body, adding non-functional aesthetic tissue where needed to achieve a desired appearance. This implant can be configured to form various body shapes according to the user's taste - or that of their partner.

Manufacture an implanted gland that uses chemicals and nanomachines to toughen the skin and form flexible keratin armor beneath it. The added protection covers the whole body, but gives the skin an unattractive leathery, wrinkled appearance.

Manufacture a signal redirector which isolates half of the brain, allowing the other half to sleep while the user remains outwardly awake. By alternating brain halves, the user never needs to sleep. Unfortunately, two hemispheres are better than one - working with half a brain causes a reduction in consciousness.
Manufacture an artificial stomach replacement with a broad-spectrum filtration and sterilization system. It allows the user to eat almost anything without ever worrying about food poisoning.

Manufacture a mechanical arm replacement for speeding up mining. It has a built-in snake drill, which allows the miner to rapidly find and exploit weak lines in the rock. It also has a general-purpose manipulator. It is somewhat ungainly, which slows down movement slightly.
Manufacture a razor-sharp blade that extends at will from a hidden opening at the end of the ulna. Appearing without warning, it can be used for devastating slice attacks.

Manufacture an agricultural hand replacement with telescoping tools that sow several holes or harvest multiple points at once. A general-purpose manipulator handles other tasks, though the bulky assembly slightly slows movement.
Manufacture an implant that releases nanomachines and healing factors to accelerate wound recovery. It treats physical injuries, not diseases or other health conditions.

Manufacture an analysis computer inspects the bloodstream, classifies pathogens, and rapidly prompts the body's natural immune system to respond to them faster than it could alone. This speeds immunity gain significantly.

projects.ds: Begin building structures capable of holding wild animals.
Build a barrel for storing water.
Build a stone cistern that stores hot water for showers and baths. Connect it to a boiler to heat the water. Holds half as much hot water as a standard hot water tank.
Build a stone-lined cesspit that collects sewage and slowly treats it. Holds 500 L and treats 50 L per day. When full, excess sewage is sent to sewage outlets.
Build a luxurious toilet that disposes of human urine and faeces while providing high comfort and beauty.\n14L per use
Build a luxurious bathroom basin that lets colonists wash their hands after using the toilet while providing high comfort and beauty.\n14L per use
Build a tank for storing water.
Build a large tank for storing water.
Build a large hot water tank that stores hot running water for showers and baths. Connect to any boiler to heat.
Build a valve that opens or closes connections between pipes.

Build a water well that provides groundwater for manual collection. Haul water to tubs for washing and drinking, or use bills to gather filled waterskins. Nearby pollution can contaminate the groundwater.
Build a tub that holds water for personal hygiene. Must be regularly refilled with fresh water, also fills with rain water. Can also be used for drinking if thirst is enabled.
Build a thin door that blocks line of sight to people using bathroom fixtures. Does not create new rooms or prevent heat loss.
Build a small mat used next to a bathtub to absorb water.
Build a trough that supplies water for animals. A service box with a ballcock valve automatically refills it when the water level is low, and rain also replenishes it.
Build a bowl that holds drinking water for animals.
Build a burn pit that eliminates fecal sludge by burning it as fuel. Can also be used for disposing of corpses or other detritus. Colonists may become sick if they spend too long near burning waste.

Build a groundwater intake that supplies groundwater to connected pumps. It cannot be operated manually. The presence of sewage or other pollution will reduce water quality and can cause contamination.
Build a water butt that stores water for use by plumbed fixtures. Slowly fills when raining. The water must be drained if it becomes contaminated. Capacity: 100.
Build a water tower that stores water for use by plumbed fixtures. The water must be drained if it becomes contaminated. Capacity: 8000.
Build a wind pump that pumps water from wells to water towers. Pumping capacity: 3000 L/day.
Build a huge water tower that stores water for use by plumbed fixtures. The water must be drained if it becomes contaminated. Capacity: 50,000.
Build a shower that uses water supplied by water towers. Can be heated via plumbed hot water tanks. Does not require a sewage outlet.\n65L per wash
Build a shower stall that uses water supplied by water towers. Can be heated via plumbed hot water tanks. Does not require a sewage outlet.\n65L per wash
Build a water fountain used for drinking and washing.
Build a kitchen sink that increases room cleanliness.
Build a hot water tank that stores hot running water for showers and baths. Connect to any boiler to heat.

Build a pipe laid into open fresh water, facing the water, which can be pumped by water pumps like a well. Rivers provide the most water, then lakes; marsh water provides the least and is stagnant, contaminating the water it is pumped into. Sea water can't be used.
Build a pit latrine that collects faeces in a hole in the ground. Must be emptied manually, or can be plumbed.\n14L per use
Build an indoor faeces and urine collection box for small animals.
Build a sewage outlet that can be placed anywhere. Sewage will pool and spread on land or disperse in water. Sewage cleans up over time; the presence of trees, water, or rain will speed this up.
Build a bathroom basin that lets colonists wash their hands after using the toilet.

Build a bathtub that provides a comfortable, leisurely wash. Can be heated by placing an adjacent campfire or log boiler, or via plumbed hot water tanks. Does not require a sewage outlet.\n190L per wash
Build a chemfuel boiler that produces 2000 heating units for radiators and hot water tanks. Requires chemfuel for fuel. Can be controlled by thermostats.
Build an electric boiler that produces a variable amount of heating units for radiators and hot water tanks. Manually controlled power setting. Can be controlled by thermostats.
Build an industrial fish breeding and harvesting facility designed to automatically extract fish from bodies of water with fish populations.
Build an automated industrial preserving system for the mass production of canned goods from various raw ingredients, requiring no manual labor.
Build artificial hives that spawn black hive insectoids.
Grow bio mech disruptors that weaken mechanoids in their radius.
Grow black creepers that convert existing creep into black creep.
Raise black defiler mounds that spit toxic black hive bile.
Grow black jelly morphers that refine insect jelly into black insect jelly.
Build hardened walls from black insect jelly.
Grow foam belchers that spray fire-retardant foam in a cone.
Grow cold-emitting freeze pods from black hive bioforms.
Learn how to construct a simple tub shaped watercraft powered by a paddle.
Build gas coolers for cold rooms using helixien gas.
Build gas heaters for warm rooms using helixien gas.
Build chemfuel heaters for warm rooms without relying on the power grid.
Build glass wall sections that let light and sight through while enclosing a room.
Begin building structures that can keep prisoners contained.
Build an electrically powered boilpot for producing patchleather.
Build an electrically powered concrete press.
Craft simple garments from leaves and plant fibers.

Sow the local biome's natural trees in your fields.
Build a brewery and fermenting vats to transform hops into tasty, tasty beer.
Build complex furniture like beds, end tables, dining chairs, armchairs, dressers, tool cabinets, billiards tables, and poker tables, vents, sarcophagi, and more.

Cut rock chunks into stone blocks for use in construction. Build beautiful stone tile floors or ugly concrete walkways.
