projects.ds: Tailor complicated garments like pants, dusters, and cowboy hats.
Build a drug lab for basic drug synthesis. Further research is required to make specific drugs.
Sow cocoa trees to create your own delicious chocolate. Eating chocolate fulfills the need for recreation and it's a valuable trade good too.
Weave beautiful carpets from cloth.
Make pemmican, a preserved mixture of meat and plant matter that doesn't go bad for a long time. Great for traveling.
Build smithies for crafting metal weapons like knives, gladii, and maces. Work metal into clean, beautiful floor tiles.
Build the recurve bow, an effective and inexpensive ranged weapon.

Manufacture a refined powdery preparation of the psychite drug. When snorted, it produces a rapid euphoric high, dramatically reduces the user's need for rest, and suppresses pain. Like all forms of psychite, it is addictive, though it is not as addictive as the cruder flake.
Synthesize wake-up, a work performance-enhancing drug which replaces the need for sleep.
Produce go-juice, a synthetic combat-performance-enhancing drug which improves shooting, melee, and movement ability, and dulls pain.
Produce penoxycyline, a disease prevention drug which blocks plague, malaria, and more before they start.
Craft immense two-handed blades that cleave through enemies with long, committed swings.
Smith suits of plate armor from metal or wood. This heavy armor noticeably slows movement, but protects very effectively.
Craft greatbows for killing enemies at great range.
Harness the power of electricity for a hundred different tasks.
u: cabled modern power pole with lamp

projects.ds: Build batteries for storing electricity.
Build biofuel refineries to make chemfuel from biological matter like wood or foodstuffs.
Build watermill generators on rivers to generate a steady supply of power.
Build nutrient paste dispensers which efficiently produce edible meals from raw nutritive feedstocks, while requiring no labor at all.
Build solar panels for electricity generation.
Build coolers to make people comfortable in hot weather, or to construct freezers for storing perishable goods.
Build autodoors which automatically open when someone approaches, without slowing anyone down.
Build hydroponics basins to rapidly grow crops indoors regardless of the terrain or weather outside.
Produce tube televisions for recreational watching.
u: AR ブラウン管テレビ
MF ブラウン管テレビ

projects.ds: Produce packaged survival meals which never go bad. Great for traveling.
Construct firefoam poppers, automatic fire-safety devices which spread fire-retardant foam in response to encroaching flames.
Build improvised traps from any kind of mortar shell.
Build geothermal power plants on top of steam geysers, for uninterrupted power.
Construct sterile tiles to make cleanrooms for safer and more effective medical treatment, research, and cooking.
Build powerful outdoors lights. Additionally, customize the color of electric lights and reduce their power consumption by half. This does not affect sun lamps.
Build machining tables to craft guns, grenades, flak armor, and to shred dead mechanoids for resources.
Build smokepop packs which allow the wearer to deploy a defensive smokescreen.

Jointed mechanical substitutes restore basic function to missing limbs without requiring advanced neural interfaces.

Manufacture an arm prosthesis. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real arm.
Craft compact repeating handguns with revolving cylinders and reliable metallic cartridges.
Craft clothing with metal armor sewn in to resist bullets and explosions. This weighty armor slows movement slightly.
Build high-angle launchers that lob explosive rounds over obstacles, and manufacture high-explosive shells for bombardment.
Craft compact self-loading handguns that chamber a fresh cartridge after each shot.
Craft compact automatic weapons that fire powerful wide-caliber rounds in controlled bursts.
Build compact automated gun emplacements that track and fire upon nearby threats.
Produce a turret which can be activated to spray fire-extinguishing foam.
Work with complex microelectronics. This unlocks the hi-tech research bench and comms console.
Produce high-resolution flatscreen televisions for greater enjoyment.
Construct moisture pumps, which very slowly normalize the moisture in the ground around them. They can turn wet ground dry and convert soft sand into normal sand.
Construct hospital beds which improve medical outcomes.
Build deep drills for extracting resources from underground. You'll need a ground-penetrating scanner to find the resources.
Build ground-penetrating scanners that can detect drillable resources under the surface. Requires an advanced component to construct.
Construct launchable transport pods that you can use to send people and supplies long distances across the planet's surface. Can be used for raiding, travel, sending gifts, and more.
Produce standard industrial-tech medicine by combining herbal medicine, neutroamine, and cloth.
Construct long-range mineral scanners your researchers can use to detect precious minerals across the planet. Can be tuned to find a specific mineral. Requires advanced components to construct.
Build wearable shield gear. Shields use momentum-repulsion technology to prevent projectiles from traversing the field boundary.
Craft versatile gas-operated rifles with controlled bursts, dependable accuracy, and effective medium-range firepower.
Produce the heavy autocannon turret.
Assemble electrically driven rotary machine guns that deliver a tremendous volume of fire.
Build multi-analyzers which increase research speed and allow higher-level research projects.
Build vitals monitors which improve medical outcomes when placed next to hospital beds.
Build fabrication benches, capable of high-tech projects ranging from component assembly to power armor construction.
Fabricate advanced components from standard components and other materials.
Construct cryptosleep caskets, which can put living beings in a state of indefinite suspended animation.
Craft recon armor, a light powered armor suit used by scout troops who need protection on the move. Note that these also require advanced components.
Build marine armor, a general-use powered armor suit used by high-tech shock troops. Note that these also require advanced components.
Craft burst-fire rifles that energize each projectile with an unstable pulse for exceptional damage and armor penetration.

Powered artificial limbs and sensory organs combine mechanical strength with neural control to replace lost anatomy.

Manufacture an advanced artificial arm. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage. It is better than a biological arm in almost every way.
Produce the armor-penetrating uranium slug turret. It fires uranium slugs which tear through plasteel like paper, but it's less effective at close range.
Produce rocketswarm launchers, single-burst turrets which can devastate a wide area at a key moment in battle.
Construct the structural and supportive elements of a starship. This is the first step in building a ship to leave this star system.
Construct hardened cryptosleep caskets tough enough to be exposed to vacuum, for transporting people on the years-long journey between stars.
Build a long-duration nuclear reactor to power a starship. Note that reactors have a long startup process that will attract raiders.

Construct a Johnson-Tanaka drive for a ship. The JT drive can push you to other stars by leveraging quantum scale effects to beam momentum to distant stars. Of course, as with all starships, it still takes many years to get anywhere.

Build a reward-signal system to persuade an existing persona core into serving as a ship's machine captain. Since people sleep during interstellar travel, a persona core is necessary to handle the complex decisions of a years-long starflight.
Construct long-range sensors for a starship. These sensors are essential for navigation, communication, and threat avoidance.
Tailor noble-specific apparel like formal shirts and royal robes.
Tailor royal apparel of the highest tier, like royal robes and crowns.
Craft cataphract armor, heavy powered armor that slows the user but which can absorb extreme punishment. Note that these also require advanced components.
Build jump packs to perform aerial assaults during combat.
Build wearable gunlinks to enhance your soldiers' shooting accuracy.

Manufacture a brain implant which inhibits nociception, or pain sensation. While it does allow the user to accomplish more, it turns out pain has a purpose. When you don't feel it, you can get hurt really bad really easily.

Manufacture a combat-oriented hand replacement consisting of a mechanical hand with a hooked claw on each finger. It cuts deep, and it is strong enough to crush a skull like a hand crushes an egg. The claws can be retracted, making it as useful as a natural hand for non-combat tasks, however its overall ungainliness slows down movement slightly.

Manufacture a razor-sharp talon which extends from a hidden opening between the middle and ring fingers. The talon is longer than the palm, but it becomes flexible upon retracting, allowing the user to curl it up and conceal it inside the hand. It can perform rapid slashing attacks, but is poor at penetrating armor.
Manufacture a pair of injectors implanted through the canine teeth, connected to a venom pump. The user can bite an enemy, extend the injectors, and pump venom into the target.
Manufacture an advanced chemical processing system breaks down nutrients the body could normally never use, leading to increased efficiency.
Manufacture a non-intelligent microcomputer controlled by a visual/tactile neural interface. It assists with memory and calculation, like a calculator and notepad embedded in the brain.
Manufacture an implanted gland that uses chemicals and nanomachines to toughen the skin. It provides modest protection against damage without noticeably changing the host's appearance.
Manufacture an implant that detects blood loss and releases clotting factors, significantly reducing bleeding.
Manufacture a facial prosthesis shaped to the host's preferences and prevalent beauty standards, improving physical impressions.

Manufacture an olfactory implant that detects airborne food compounds through an ultrafine absorption mesh. A processor translates the readings into detailed nerve signals, improving cooking through a heightened sense of smell without changing the host's appearance.
Manufacture an artificial gland that produces chemicals and nanomachines to clear toxin buildup from the brain.
Craft the harp, a simple stationary musical instrument popular among nobility in some cultures.
Craft the harpsichord, a complex stationary musical instrument.
Craft the piano, an advanced stationary musical instrument.
Construct biosculpter pods which can perform various biological alterations to colonists. These are especially important to believers in transhumanism.

Unlock the biosculpter pod's bioregeneration cycle. This cycle heals old scars, regenerates small lost body parts like fingers and toes, and cures many of the physical maladies that come with old age.

Construct neural supercharger devices. Neural superchargers improve consciousness and learning rate, but they also increase hunger and the effect must be refreshed daily. Transhumanists often hold neural supercharging as an important practice.
The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control basic-tier mechanoids.
The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control standard-tier mechanoids.\n\nYou can get signal chips by using a mechanitor to summon a diabolus threat.
The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control high-tier mechanoids.\n\nYou can get powerfocus chips by using a mechanitor to summon a war queen threat.

The advanced technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control ultra-tier mechanoids, including large mechs and ultra-tier mechanitor gear.\n\nYou can get nano structuring chips by using a mechanitor to summon an apocriton threat.
Build wastepack atomizers which can safely dispose of toxic wastepacks by decomposing them at the molecular level.
Create toxifier generators which generate electricity, but also spread pollution around themselves.
Begin producing xenotype altering xenogerms from extracted genes.
u: animal Upsy Daisy vampirey healy power

projects.ds: Build gene processors, which allow a gene assembler to create xenogerms of higher genetic complexity.
Allows a gene assembler to use archite capsules to create seemingly impossible genes. Archite genes and archite capsules can be obtained from traders.

Manufacture an artificial secondary vascular system that unseals during deathrest, vastly improving the rate of hemogenic circulation and deathrest regeneration.

Can only be installed on pawns with the deathrest gene.

Perform the surgeries necessary to create a test tube embryo from a fertile man and woman, then implant the embryo in a surrogate mother or growth vat. Also, perform sterilization surgeries on men and women.
Craft hand-thrown canisters that release a lingering cloud of caustic tox gas.

Manufacture an advanced artificial kidney. Using a series of nanofilters, it can rapidly remove a vast range of toxins from the blood, making it effective against environmental toxins, venoms, and injected poisons.
Construct growth vats which can gestate an embryo or accelerate a child's growth.
Extract bioferrite directly from captured entities. Use it to craft weapons and apparel at a crafting spot or bioferrite shaper.
Build bioferrite harvesters that automatically extract bioferrite from captured entities. Produces more bioferrite than manual extraction.
Shape and re-form bioferrite into useful tools, weapons, flooring, and more.
Create advanced weapons that use bioferrite as a fuel source.
Build power generators that burn bioferrite as a fuel.
Craft special void sculptures from bioferrite to enhance the quality of psychic rituals.
Restructure archotech shards into limited-use weapons that shock, manipulate, and destroy enemies using archotechnology.
Restructure archotech shards into limited-use weapons that twist living targets into terrifying creatures.
Build bioferrite-powered heaters that produce enough heat to warm an entire region.

Build shard-powered structures that generate a frenetic psychic field to make anyone nearby move and work faster. However, the unstable emotional energy creates a tendency towards violence, irritating anyone nearby.
Build shard-powered structures that stimulate those nearby to prevent fatigue. The device will irritate anyone nearby.
Build holding platforms and inhibitors to better contain entities.
Build a generator that draws electricity from contained entities. This process aggravates entities, making them harder to contain.
Build bioferrite-based flare packs that reveal invisible creatures and light up an area.
Build a device that can detect invisible creatures.
Build a psychic ritual spot and perform psychic rituals. Use the void provocation ritual to discover new entities.
Perform a psychic ritual which will draw a herd of animals.
Perform a psychic ritual which will draw a horde of animated corpses. While hostile, the corpses won't attack your colony directly. They can be captured for study.

Perform a psychic ritual that causes a target to age rapidly. The ritual invoker will become younger in the process. The target will suffer brain damage as a result, which may be lethal for elderly targets.
Perform a psychic ritual which deadens a target's psychic sensitivity and temporarily boosts the ritual invoker's psychic sensitivity. The target will suffer brain damage as a side-effect.
Perform a psychic ritual that abducts a random hostile person from anywhere in the world, putting them in a short-term coma for capture.
Perform a psychic ritual which provokes fleshbeasts to emerge from the ground near enemies, attacking anyone nearby.
Perform advanced psychic rituals.
Perform a psychic ritual which causes underground fleshbeasts to open up a massive hole in the ground. The hole leads down to a fleshbeast-infested cavern which can be explored for resources.
Perform a psychic ritual which grants death refusal to an individual, allowing them to self-resurrect once after dying.
Perform a psychic ritual that drains experience from a victim and gives it to the invoker. The process will dull the target's mind, weakening their skills and causing brain damage.
Perform a psychic ritual that makes everyone in the region happier but reduces their desire to work.
Perform a psychic ritual that makes everyone in the region work faster but become more irritable.
Perform a psychic ritual which causes blood-like psychofluid to fall from the sky. Anyone caught outside will soon be driven into a berserk rage.

Perform a psychic ritual which erases much of a person's episodic memories. Traumatic events will be forgotten. Resistant prisoners will become easier to recruit. Allows recruiting unwaveringly loyal prisoners.
Build a serum lab to synthesize high-tech serums. Serums harness archotechnological power to bestow a temporary effect on the user.
Synthesize metalblood serums that make the user more resistant to damage.
Synthesize a serum that stabilizes a person's mood, preventing mental breaks.
Synthesize a serum which temporarily increases the user's strength and speed, and allows them to recover from injuries faster. However, it reduces their mood.
Perform a surgery that lobotomizes a person, making them happier while rendering them incapable of intellectual and skilled labor.

Perform a surgery that infuses a living person with an archotech shard, transforming them into a terrifying ghoul. Ghouls are strong melee combatants but are incapable of doing work. Ghouls will go mad if they are not fed enough raw meat.

Manufacture a number of barbed bioferrite spikes that can be surgically attached to a ghoul. They drastically increase a ghoul's melee damage but also limit its range of motion, slowing it down.

Due to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.
Synthesize a serum that can bring dead ghouls back to life.
Craft devices that produce clouds of microscopic archites. The archites can reanimate corpses to produce deadly shamblers that will only attack your enemies.
Modify a revenant spine so that it can be implanted in a human, allowing them to become temporarily invisible.
Build a wearable pack that allows the user to deploy a battery-powered turret.
Build heavily reinforced structures. It's a good choice if you want to keep something dangerous out - or in.
Place zones where your colonists can go fishing.
Refine chemfuel into astrofuel and store it in pressurized tanks. Unlocks the construction of the gravjumper engine, allowing the first steps into gravship travel.
Unlock gravship engines capable of lifting a colony into orbit. Allows construction of control terminals for new gravship systems such as gravtech research and maintenance.
Unlock gravhulks, massive gravships capable of supporting entire colonies. Also allows crafting of gravlite panels, essential ultratech material for advanced gravship construction.
Build vac barriers to protect against depressurization, and orbital scanners to detect locations in space.
Build heavy bridges that support heavy buildings. You can use this to build whole colonies on the water.
Craft sweeping gamma-ray lasers that pierce heavy armor and ignite exposed targets.

Build a shuttle which can be used for long distance travel or to reach orbit. This requires a shuttle engine which can be bought from orbital traders, salvaged from other shuttles, or obtained through quests.
Build traps and wearable packs that release hunter drones. These explosive drones pursue hostiles and detonate when within range.
Construct advanced moisture pumps, equipped with better engines and a larger tank. These upgrades allow for a larger range, faster pumping speed and more moist ground to be pumped dry.
Craft charged sidearms that burn through armor and short-circuit shields and machinery.
Craft improved and lighter orbital apparel that's less restrictive and can protect against the harsh vacuum of space. Note that these also require advanced components.
Craft orbital armor, a medium vacuum-sealed powered armor suit used by born-on-board orbital forces. Note that these also require advanced components.

Craft security armor is a lightweight, vacuum-sealed powered suit used by security forces and battleroids. It offers enhanced mobility and features a built-in range shield. Note that these suits require advanced components. Suits like these were used by battleroids to defend against boarding invaders on starships during orbit.
Unlocks buildings capable of wirelessly charging Automatons.

Learn how to replace all that weak flesh with superior plasteel. Required for most type of conversions of biological characters into machines.\n\nNote unless you have mods adding android surgery or android building all this research does is enable the surgery to repair damaged android brains.
Excavate and preserve fossils, and display your colony's finest history for guests across the Rim to enjoy.

Manufacture a special bioferrite prosthetic that allows a chimera to further saturate its bloodstream with stress hormones and liquid energy during its rage speed. The chimera will be able to attack faster and move faster compared to normal rage speed. The prosthetic somewhat increases the chimera's metabolism, causing it to eat more.

This prosthetic is too painful to be installed on normal animals. It's still painful for chimeras when not in rage speed, but they can handle it due to their body being used to large quantities of stress hormones and liquid energy.
Build sepulchral buildings to honor the deceased and embellish your catacombs and crypts.
Create specifically treated buildings that are soothing for people with the bloodfeeder gene.
Manufacture an implanted explosive charge that detonates when its host dies.
Manufacture an implanted electromagnetic charge that activates when its host dies, disabling nearby electronics and turrets.
Build a composter for turning sewage into fertilizer for increasing the fertility of diggable terrain.
Build standard and hidden pipes that connect plumbing fixtures.

Build log boilers that produce 2000 heating units for piped radiators and hot water tanks, and hot water tanks that store hot running water for showers and baths. A log boiler heats the room and adjacent baths, and requires wood logs for fuel.
Build thermostats, radiators, large radiators and heated towel rails that distribute and control heat through a piped water system.

Build water heaters for hot water tanks and radiators: chemfuel boilers (2000 heating units), electric boilers with a manual power setting, and geothermal water heaters (7000 heating units). Boilers can be controlled by thermostats.

Build fueled and electric sauna heaters and slatted seating for sauna rooms. The heaters warm a room to 60°C, and regular sauna use reduces the risk of heart attacks. Electric heaters also require Electricity research.
Build a toilet that disposes of human urine and faeces.\n14L per use
Build an electric pump that pumps water from wells to water towers. Pumping capacity: 1500 L/day.
Build a power shower that heats water on demand without a hot water tank and cleans twice as fast.\n90L per wash

Build a comfortable, self-cleaning smart toilet that cannot become blocked and uses water efficiently. Provides the optimum multi-functional experience with automatic cleansing and deodorization.\n7L per use
Build a hot tub that provides hydrotherapy, relaxation and recreation. Filled with water from water towers on first use. Self-heated and does not require a sewage outlet.
Build pumping stations that pump water from wells to water towers (10000 L/day), and deep water wells that reach clean water far below the surface.
Build a washing machine that washes clothes so well that you can't even tell someone died wearing it!
Build a water treatment unit that removes 99.99% of germs. Filters existing water in storage towers, and any water used by fixtures, eliminating the risk of disease.

Manufacture an advanced artificial bladder. A chemical recycling system breaks down waste products from the body into molecules which are recycled with the remainder released as gas, the downside of this being that it gives the user gas.
Build a septic tank that slowly cleans sewage over time. Sewage is directed to septic tanks first. If it reaches full capacity, excess sewage is sent to sewage outlets.
Build a sewage treatment unit that slowly cleans sewage over time. If it reaches full capacity then excess sewage is sent directly to sewage outlets without treatment.

Build swimming pools for hydrotherapy, relaxation and recreation, including modular sections that join into a pool of any size and shape. Supply water from water towers; piping water into any modular section fills the connected pool.
Build a fire sprinkler that activates in response to fire or high temperatures. Douses flames with a spray of water.
Compact high-efficiency recycling nodes that recover and reuse water from showers and sinks.
Extract and sublimate volatile ices trapped beneath asteroid regolith.
Build luxurious bathroom fixtures that provide high comfort and add beauty to the room: royal baths, royal basins and royal toilets.
Assemble steam engines.
Assemble medium engines.
Assemble turbine engines.
Create neurostimulators which enhance learning speed of pawns inside growth vats the machines are attached to.
Learn how to assemble VR simulators and, advanced machines that greatly enhance learning speed of pawns inside growth vats in a radius around them and allow them to recieve passions and traits.
By using high-grade heat treated steel for components, we can dramatically increase their durability.
By using composite materials infused with self-repairing nanobots, we can further increase component lifespans.
Learning how to basic disassemble and reassemble weapons, assembly is an easy task when using standardized components.
Craft compact rail sidearms that implant ionizing particles and trigger disruptive EMP bursts.
Learn how to construct logical switches, sensors, wire crossings, and timers to automate power grids and colony systems.
The dissection of corpses can improve the medical knowledge. This research unlocks the dissection table.

Develop pharmaceutical compounds capable of satisfying neurochemical cravings without producing the harmful effects of the original addictive substance. Allows the production of alcohol treatment pills.
Produce cyanide, a highly dangerous poison that usually kills its victim within an hour.
Produce antitox, a medicine that reduces the amount of toxic particles absorbed from the air by coating the lungs with a chemical filter.

Produce aniracetam, a nootropic known to help increase memory capacity, learning ability, and focus. It causes extreme mental decline after use, which may be lethal when combined with other health problems.
Produce hydra, a dense, mechanite-based powder that helps heal wounds and scars, similar to the healing properties of luciferium. Take once every 15 days for the effect to occur.
Produce upper, a stimulant that gives the user a short burst of immense speed. It is moderately addictive, with long-term use leading to kidney failure and muscle spasms.

Produce addictol, a synthetic medicine used for addiction replacement therapy. It replicates the effects of other drugs without the high, helping addicts remove their addictions more quickly. However, addictol is very addictive itself.
Build a digital storage for your research papers.

Develop a foundational understanding of how to apply salvaged ultratech components from region effecting devices.

Lacking the proper ultratech toolings, the machines your colony reverse engineers are likely to be mildly less potent.

All researched adjusters are grouped under one drop down in the "Misc" architect tab.

While the simplest of the regional adjusters, replicating the intricate plumbing, machine casing, power source, and exciting the self-reproducing reaction belched from the spewer apparatus still proves quite the technical undertaking.
Building off the smoke spewer, this adjuster releases self-reproducing poison vapors. The internal dispersal system workings are notably more sophisticated to facilitate this.
Deviating greatly from the prior two spewers, the defoliater focuses it's efforts on sterilizing landscapes.\n\nAll while operating out of a much smaller footprint.
The EMI dynamo demands higher electrical overhead to generate it's electromagnetic field.\n\nThis improved power system will be vital to pave the way for the more sophisticated adjusters.
The intricate field generator used to manifest the opaque sun blocking sheath at high altitudes requires a very careful reconstruction of the intricate emitter compositions.

Likely the second most useful adjuster, creating a weather controller involves successfully connecting to an ancient network of weather-control satellites.\n\nReliably maintaining a link with the network demands spoofing access codes, and staying within failsafe thresholds to prevent an unauthorized intrusion lock out.

Generally the most coveted adjuster, creating a climate adjuster requires successfully connecting to an ancient network of climate-alteration satellites.\n\nReliably maintaining a link with the network demands spoofing access codes, and staying within failsafe thresholds to prevent an unauthorized intrusion lock out.
Build weight racks to organize workout equipment and support focused strength training.

Learn to craft an easel, wherein you can create classical paintings. Also learn to tailor a smock, construct art props and construct art cabinets, which can be placed near the easel to speed up art production.
Learn to create modern art and posters using an easel. Also unlocks more art props, such as tins of paint and art mats.

Allows building makeshift fuses; can be placed anywhere on a power network with batteries. Each one is enough to safely dissipate up to 1800 Wd (three standard batteries) discharge, but will require repairs if tripped.

Allows building circuit breakers; can be placed anywhere on a power network with batteries. Each one is enough to safely dissipate up to 1800 Wd (three standard batteries) discharge, and will need to be manually reset if tripped.
Gain the ability to restrict powered doors to only be accessible to colonists holding a key card with sufficent clearance.
Highly customizable advanced walls, capable of warning of hostile presences and taking a good amount of damage.
Build sealing platforms to contain dark spirits and entities.

projects.ds: Build massive sealed doors to contain dark spirits and entities.

projects.ds: Unlocks a range of specialized artisanal processes, enabling colonists to craft unique, niche products using traditional methods and tools that complement the colony’s production capabilities.
Unlocks techniques for transforming raw milk into a variety of dairy products, such as yogurt, cream, and condensed milk.
Unlocks the knowledge of fermenting various produce into vinegar.
Unlocks additional recipes for the artisan fermenter to ferment miso, kefir, lassi, sake, and more.
Unlocks recipes for expertly grinding produce into fine flours, crisp chips, vibrant zests, and smooth purees, elevating the colony's production capabilities.
Unlocks techniques for extracting oils from a variety of plants and seeds, enabling the production of valuable artisan oils.
Unlocks advanced methods for bottling liquids, improving the preservation, storage, and trade of jams, mayonnaise and other artisanal products.

Unlocks a range of more complex artisanal processes. This research project will unlock all recipes that require another artisanal product to craft, such as for example sour cream, requiring milk and vinegar.
Unlocks techniques for infusing flavors into other artisan crafts, allowing colonists to craft infused oils, vinegars, and other enhanced artisanal products.
The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control Apex-tier mechanoids. You can get chips by using a mechanitor to summon a Three Lords threat. They can also be summoned separately.
The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control Advanced-tier mechanoids. You can get chips by using a mechanitor to summon a Gazer threat.
Build glittertech fabricator and unlock forming glittercores.
Build light glitterpanels and link them to the glittertech fabricator.
Build advanced and useful glittertech utilities.
Build dark glitterpanels and link them to the glittertech fabricator.
Manufacture a simple tracking device designed to tune the user’s brain waves to accept sudden translocations. It establishes a link to a telepad.
Learn how to harness powerful nanotechnology to disassemble mechanoids with pinpoint accuracy and fortify your surroundings.
Build powerful and heavy glittertech machines.
Learn how to change atomic structure of objects.
Grasp the basics of utilizing medicine based mechanites.
Understand the power of deep memory cloning and understand mechanisms behind complex neuromodifiers.
Manufacture an advanced tooth replacement that improves everyday quality of life. Each tooth contains a microprocessor that adjusts to the wearer’s needs and comfort.

Learn how to overclock inner weapon components with an advanced mechanites coating designed to make firearms more efficient and form additional upgrades.

Weapons with this powerful yet unstable mechanism are known to sporadically combust unless they're stabilized by upgrades or their user is non-flammable.

The overclocking recipe will be available at the glittertech fabricator.
Manufacture an advanced plasteel skin prothesis with crystalline atomic structure. It's full of glittertech medical cells making it soft in touch, flexible, and extremely durable.
Make combat related skilltrainers.
Make engineering related skilltrainers.
Make intellectual related skilltrainers.
Make survival related skilltrainers.
Learn how to form a powerful resurrector mech serum using a blueprint glitterpanel.

Manufacture a bionic implant that provides access to cyberspace. implants allow installation of other implants and enable hackers to interact with cyber entities more efficiently. Although it offers many benefits, it can also trigger specialized security-system responses that are normally ineffective against disconnected hackers.
Technology describing usage of neural ports in machines.
Advanced technology teaching complex hacking methods.

Manufacture an implant that links exec data to the cyberlink with nanoconnectors, allowing the usage and training of execs.

Execs are trained during hacking.

Manufacture an implanted neural interface capable of supplying the user with information relevant to their current situaltion. Such information is stored on data chips that can be freely inserted and removed. This port can hold one skill chip per skill.
Upgrade standard bionic and archotech parts to accept modular enhancements.

Manufacture a bionic module that allows the user to extend an impossibly thin and sharp crystal-metallic fillament whip.

Modules can be self-installed into modified bionic or archotech parts, but can only be ejected by removing the part.

Manufacture reinforced bioferrite armor with neural assistors for surgical attachment to vulnerable areas. It significantly reduces incoming damage but still slows movement. Only ghouls can tolerate the installation's extreme pain.

Manufacture a bio-mechanical organ that allows the user to temporarily gain impossible regeneration. The implant is crafted from a modified dreadmeld core, using archotech shards to control the growth mechanisms. The user can unbind the functions of the core, causing new flesh to sprout in place of their wounds. However, if used too frequently, there's a chance of the regeneration going rampant, incapacitating the user as huge masses of flesh sprout from their body, becoming fleshbeasts.

Manufacture an implant that allows the user to project a pulse of pure mental pain. The implant is crafted from a modified nociosphere emitter, using archotech shards to harness its psychic capabilities. The user can release a wave of psychic agony, briefly incapacitating all creatures nearby. However, while the user is in pain, the implant also constantly causes a feedback loop of psychic pain to all creatures that spend too much time in the user's presence.

Manufacture an implant that allows the user to temporarily partially shift into the void. The implant is crafted from modified noctolith sensors, using archotech shards to control the phase mechanisms. The user can activate the device, causing them to move and attack far faster in darkness. However, the inverse is true in light. While active, the user is unthreatened by unnatural darkness.

Manufacture an implant that enhances the combative capabilities of its host. The implant is crafted from the archometallic seed of a metalhorror, using an archotech shard to control and manipulate the growth of the creature. The symbiont’s metallic filaments weave through the host’s body, forming a second musculature system and the metalblood flowing through the host’s veins hardens in response to physical trauma. Due to the symbiont’s presence, any attempt by other metalhorrors to colonise the host will be rapidly destroyed. Upon death, the mechanisms that slave the metalhorror to the host will fail, allowing it to immediately tear free of the corpse.

Manufacture an implant that grants its user immunity to acid. The implant is crafted from the archite stomach lining that prevents devourers from digesting themselves and maintained by the influence of an archotech shard. By implanting a thin layer of these archites between the dermal layers, the user gains immunity to acid damage, and cannot be digested.

Manufacture an implant that allows the user to enthrall another person. The implant is crafted from a modified golden cube, using archotech shards to control its psychic influence. The user radiates an aura of perfection and beauty, enhanced by their psychic sensitivity, and gains the ability to focus this psychic field into the mind of another, rapidly captivating and luring them into the user's faction. The victim will always feel strong positive emotions for the beguiler but will enter a berserk rage when they die.
Perform a surgery that deforms a person, making them hideous and slow but incredibly strong.

Manufacture an implant that enhances the speed and pain resistance of the user after taking damage. The implant is crafted from the archotechnological adrenal glands of a chimera, using an archotech shard to stimulate the release procedure. By pumping a combination of synthetic superadrenaline and archites into the bloodstream, the user is able to move much faster and ignore their pain for a period of time after recieving enough damage. Unfortunately, the presence of hyper-adrenaline in the body boosts aggression levels, leading to increased chances of social fights.

Manufacture an implant that is formed of hundreds of telescopic, subdermally implanted bioferrite quills and connected to implanted nerves. The implant is crafted from harvested gorehulk nervous systems, using an archotech shard to safely fuse with the user. The retractable spines extend from the user's flesh to impale those who harm them in melee range.

Manufacture an implant that makes the user far stronger as a shambler, and revives them as one upon death. The implant consists of a strange archo-organ surrounded by twisting bioferrite pipes and uses an archotech shard at it's core to maintain and supercharge any deadlife archites present in the user’s body.

Manufacture an implant that allows its user escape death by causing it. The implant is formed of a ring of jagged, chaotic void metal and uses an archotech shard to flay a corpse of it's lingering psychic energy. After murdering 50 humanoids, the collar gains enough psychic energy to produce a seed of death refusal archites.

Slayers collars serve as a symbol of eternal servitude among worshippers of Horax.
Perform a surgery that deforms a person, making them disturbingly thin and brittle but inhumanly fast.
Perform a surgery that lobotomizes a person, rendering them deaf to psychic phenomena
Perform a surgery that lobotomizes a person, rendering them unable to feel the full range of human emotion.

Manufacture an implant that sustains the user during meditation and psychic rituals. The implant uses dark archotechnology to allow its user to tap into the ambient psychic field of a distant archotech, enabling to enter a psychic trance that sustains their body.
Perform a surgery that lobotomizes a person, rendering them unable to feel pain

Manufacture an artificial, industrial skeleton affixed to the original, with responsive, motorised joints. It is designed to take a lot of the strain of carrying heavy objects off of the body, thus increasing carrying capacity.

Manufacture an improved set of artificial hemogen glands that allow a sangophage to more efficiently convert blood into hemogen.

Can only be installed on pawns with the hemogenic gene.
Use nerve-gel split-links to install an extra pair of artificial limbs. Archotech arms are always perfectly controllable but human-made limbs require some adjustment time.
Implant explosive shells that can be detonated at will.

Manufacture a suit of subdermally installed, lightly powered armour, formed of thin, semi-flexible plasteel plates and substituted by hyperweave where higher degrees of movement are necessary. Slim neuro-memetic assistors allow the user to move naturally.

Armour like this is often used by diplomats and undercover agents, where appearances are critical.
Manufacture a miniature, retractable turret implanted on the shoulder. It's AI allows it to autonomously fire, even on the move, though it's size limits it's effectiveness.
Manufacture an implant that, through the use of special shielding and shock-dissipation filaments, defends other implants from EMP shock.
Manufacture an advanced artificial tail. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while a biogel nerve-extension on the Coccyx gives exquisit control.
Manufacture an array of psyfocus enhancing implants featuring embedded eltex weave. They were considered high fashion amongst nobility, half a century ago.
Manufacture a collection of advanced mechanites able to strategically fortify and reinforce the users body in response to the types of damage it commonly sustains.

Manufacture an artificial faceplate with toxin filtering and enhanced sensory capabilities. Nerve-gel split-links extending from the optic nerves allow the user to process visual stimuli from an array of digital eyes, granting greatly enhanced vision and night sight. This disturbing implant is most commonly seen upon members of the most brutal and savage of urbworld transhumanist gangs.

Manufacture an implanted projectile-repulsion device, designed to provide a window of defence against small bandit and animal attacks, until backup can arrive. Due to the simplified, minimised design of the implant, it does not recharge and must be refueled between uses, though it also protects from melee damage. It is most commonly used by frontier world travelers and wealthy explorers.

Requires 20 uranium to refuel.
Manufacture an implanted projectile-repulsion device, designed to protect from incoming projectiles while allowing outgoing fire.
Collect scarlet sludge from the air.
Build basic plasteel magnets for faster net workflow.
Build scarlet arches for more advanced scarlet particles attraction.
Collect scarlet particles from the far atmosphere.
Clean and compress scarlet sludge. Produce profitable drugs and learn about basic mechanites behavior.
Produce scarlet smelling salts, an useful medical drug.
Produce red-flicker, a powerful combat-enhancing drug that should be used with caution.
Synthesize last-wish, a dangerous, unstable drug with multiple usages.
Synthesize Luciferium, a drug known across universe.
Build an andvanced version of scarlet collectors and scarlet attractors when your planet runs out of scalret sludge.
Build Luciferium synthesizer and precision boosters.
Create devices that can merge mechanoid systems, enhancing various characteristics.
Create advanced upgrades for mechanoids.

projects.ds: A condiment is a spice, sauce, or preparation that is added to food, either after or during cooking, to impart a specific flavor, to enhance the flavor, or to complement the dish. All condiments are created at the condiment prep table.

Soup is a primarily liquid food, generally served warm or hot, that is made by combining ingredients of meat or vegetables with stock, or water. Hot soups are additionally characterized by boiling solid ingredients in liquids in a pot until the flavors are extracted. This research also gives access to the electric pot necessary to cook soups.

Grilling is a form of cooking that involves dry heat applied to the surface of food, commonly from above, below or from the side. Grilling usually involves a significant amount of direct, radiant heat, and tends to be used for cooking meat and vegetables quickly. This research gives access to the grill.

Deep frying (also referred to as deep fat frying) is a cooking method in which food is submerged in hot fat, most commonly oil, as opposed to the shallow oil used in conventional frying done in a frying pan. This research gives access to the deep fryer.

Canning is a method of preserving food in which the food contents are processed and sealed in an airtight container (jars like Mason jars, and steel and tin cans). Canning provides a shelf life of several years. A freeze-dried canned product, such as canned dried lentils, could last as long as 30 years in an edible state. This research gives access to the canning machine.
Unlocks techniques for creative baking, enabling colonists to craft decorated cakes, cupcakes, and cookies with colorful designs and sweet flair.

Haute cuisine is the pinnacle of culinary artistry, emphasizing meticulous preparation, refined techniques, and exquisite presentation. It transforms the finest ingredients into visually stunning and harmoniously balanced dishes, elevating dining to an experience of sophistication. This research also unlocks the haute section, a specialized workstation for crafting these masterful creations.
Stew is a form of a very nourishing meal, cooked in bulk over fire. This research also gives access to the wood-fired pot necessary to cook stews.

Craft togas, everyday wear of the citizens of the republic.\n\nNOTE: This project has a significantly increased requirement due to its proprietary nature. An easier method of learning this knowledge would be directly from Neolithic republics on the world map.

Craft the pipe organs, an incredibly advanced and intricate stationary musical instrument.
Build noble decorations like royal rugs, mirrors, grand chairs, imperial slabs, candelabras, and more.
Construct the most grand, most beautiful stellic throne for your high ranking nobility.
Craft janissary armor, light powered armor that’s commonly used by imperial recon troops. Note that these also require advanced components.
Create imperial megaturrets: Kontarion, Onager and Palintone, as well as their ammunition.
Craft powerful imperial mortar shells, such as shrapnel, armor piercing and cluster.
Build advanced explosive traps with remote detonation mechanism.
Replicating the cutting-edge Imperial armor technology. Their production involves a complex and labor-intensive process, requiring significant expertise and resources.
Collect a mass of insect jelly to create a habitable breeding ground for basic colony-owned insectoids.
Build artificial hives that spawn Sorne geneline insectoids.
Build artificial hives that spawn Chelis geneline insectoids, and raise thornworm mounds that unleash rapidly growing chitin thorns.
Learn how to keep bees to produce honey from nearby plants. Honey can be used in creation of sweetrolls and mead.
Plant grapes which can then be used to create wine must and eventually, high quality wine.
Learn to plant various alchemical ingredients and combining them into different draughts at an alchemy lab.
Learn to construct various medieval structures, including cloth walls.
Learn to build various tools and devices to enhance the productivity of the workbenches.
Craft crude handheld gunpowder tubes that launch devastating shot at short range.

Unlock the capability to utilize and manage fire for various purposes. Unlocks firefighting job.
Learn to grow various staple crops. Unlocks growing job.

Learn the absolute basic techniques of building and structural design. Unlocks the ability to build walls and roofs.

Soybean fermentation is the process by which soybeans are submitted to a chemical breakdown by bacteria, yeasts, or other microorganisms, transforming into new products. This research gives access to the soy sauce fermenter.
Build automated transport belts for efficiently transporting materials around the colony.

Build industrial-grade generators, capable of storing significantly more fuel and producing higher power.

Construct spacertech green power generators, including advanced solar panels and wind turbines.
The ultimate power generation method, nuclear power is as sufficient as it is deadly.
Build tidal generators on water to produce a large volume of sustainable green energy.
Build large machining, smithing and tailoring tables for faster work.
Build tough storage containers suitable for a industrial-era colony with methods for efficiently storing and organizing large quantities of resources using modern technologies.

Build advanced storage containers suitable for spacefaring colonies and vessels with methods for efficiently storing and organizing large quantities of resources while using the least amount of space.

Adapt spacecraft weaponry as part of your defensive systems.
Develop EMP traps and tesla blasters capable of stunning mechanoids.

Construct gravship artillery and point defense turrets to fight other ships in orbit or provide bombardments from the sky.

Harvest and store oxygen for use on gravships. Unlocks construction of vacsuits and other survival gear needed to operate in vacuum.
Construct astrofuel synthesizers that automatically convert chemfuel into astrofuel for gravship use.

Harvest structural heat generated during gravship launches and dissipate it safely. Excess heat can be converted into usable power. Heatsink capacity and power output is increased.

Research the helixien gas and it's ability to act as a combustible fuel.
Learn the techniques of caring for flowers during their blooming phase, allowing your colony to plant blooming flowers.
Vegetable milk extraction allows the colonists to extract milk from rice, oats, almonds, coconuts and soybeans.
Tailor and craft complex eltex apparel, capable of improving psychic focus of your psycasters, as well as an eltex-infused staff.
Craft simple psycaster apparel, armor and gear using eltex.

Build a a fast, insectlike combat mechanoid armed with a vicious sharp blade on its head. It isn't as dangerous as other close-ranged mechanoids, such as scythers, but they usually appear in greater numbers.

Build a humanoid mechanoid equipped with a powerful tesla gun, a fearsome energy weapon designed to unleash a cascade of electromagnetic energy upon its targets. Capable of generating a burst of EMP energy that can stun and disable mechanoids with a single shot. At the same time, it unleashes a searing bolt of electrical energy that can burn through organic targets, leaving them smoldering and vulnerable.

Build a heavy combat mechanoid with a humanoid body plan. They are faster than centipedes, and are usually armed with heavy mechanoid weapons or needle guns.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Faster than a centipede, but weaker due to their weaker weapons. If built by the player, it will have a "Swap weapon" ability to choose between the charge blaster and the Needle gun. If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Centipede Gunner.

Build a particularly dangerous tank-shaped mechanoid. Armed with a Siegebreaker Cannon that fires explosive shells, they can detect a hostile presence from hundreds of meters away, acting as unrelenting siege weapons that can obliterate even the strongest defense. Their movement is incredibly slow, and their cannon takes a very long time to recharge, but they should be treated as priority targets in most cases.

Research technology that harnesses advanced energy manipulation techniques to create focused and directed energy beams that can be transmitted across vast distances, and enable the summoning of the formidable Infernus mechanoid.

A communication method that operates on a framework of relay stations positioned across the system. These relay stations, known as "voidlinks," use subspace communication technology to transmit messages at near-light speed, allowing for rapid communication across sub-stellar distances. Enables the summoning of the War Empress mechanoid.

A cutting-edge communication system that leverages the principles of quantum mechanics to transmit information using more than just binary states of 0s and 1s. The use of these qubits allows for the transmission of complex data, instructions, or commands in a highly efficient and secure manner. Enables the summoning of the Apoptosis mechanoid.

A technology that involves the use of advanced cryptographic algorithms to achieve perfect synchronization and coordination between multiple mechanoid units or systems. It allows for seamless communication, information exchange, and coordination.
The technology needed to build a Singularity containment cell, voidlink mech recharger, and gestate Starfires.\n\nYou can get starfire chips by using a mechanitor to summon a starfire threat.

Construct specialized tanks, capable of storing large quantities of neutroamine, as well as pipes, taps and drain to move neutroamine through the system.

Harvest fine, stringy material from silkworms.

Research the application of practical knowledge and skills to design, construct, and maintain structures and machines. It encompasses a range of activities, from building fortifications and castles to creating intricate siege engines and water mills.
Harness the power of the wind to automate grinding wheatlike and sawing lumberlike products.
Harness the power of the water to automate grinding wheatlike and sawing lumberlike products.
Craft a mechanically compact bow. Requires less skill to wield, but is long to reload.
Craft a heavier version of the crossbow to decimate your enemies.
Research how to construct a huge ballista. Fires huge ballista bolts at a medium rate of fire.
Research how to construct a huge trebuchet. Powerful and deadly but takes a long time to reload.
Research how to construct a huge ballista repeater. Fires powerful and deadly shots in quick sucession but takes a long time to reload.
Unlocks the alchemy workbench, a dedicated station for brewing herbal extracts, refining unusual ingredients, and preparing alchemical medicines and mixtures.
Discover new techniqures of metallurgy and steel manufacturing.
Discover advanced techniques of metallurgy and mithril forging.
Discover how to make tar
Discover the perfect formula in utilizing gunpowder for weaponry.
Learn how to sew padded clothing, granting better protection against physical threats.
Learn the techniques of linking chains to smith formidable chainmail armors.
Build hunting bows, a strong bow used for obtaining game.
Craft the ultimate longbow, dangerous especially at long range.
Learn how to craft basic polearms.
Learn how to craft military polearms.
Learn how to craft noble polearms.
Craft simple weighted clubs that deliver dependable crushing blows.
Craft balanced one-handed bludgeons designed for sustained military combat.
Craft compact noble hammers that concentrate force against armored opponents.
Craft broad, stout single-edged blades for militia close combat.
Craft reliable one-handed swords suited to soldiers, guards, and shield formations.
Research how to sow basic plants.
A rare luscious fruit that grows on small tree. As per it's given name, the red fruit is a delicacy to griffons and are typically guarded by them.
Research how to plow soil.
Learn basic recipes of dishes.
Learn intermediate recipes of dishes.
Learn advanced recipes of dishes.
Learn how to smoke fresh meat into dried slabs of jerky to prolong shelf life and add rustic flavours to meals.
Learn how to sear meat over an open flame, creating delicious seared sausages and meats.
Learn how to make hearty and nutritious stews, such as pumpkin and lentil soups.
Learn how to bake meals such as bread or even luxurious desserts such as apple pies.

Build automated machines that extract and refine raw materials: the automated smelter, drill platform, heavy-duty saw and biofuel refinery.
Build automated machines that grow, catch and process food, such as the automated farmer and automated mincer.
Build automated machines that craft finished goods, such as the automated loom and automated ammunition press. They can only output goods of normal quality.
Build conveyor-fed factories that process goods in bulk: the conveyor oven, conveyor crematorium, automated distillery, drug granulator and neutroamine synthesizer.
Build conveyor-fed factories for precision manufacturing: the automated alloy forge, automated assembler and automated machining bay. The machining bay can only output goods of normal quality.
Build luxury furniture focused strongly on aesthetics and beauty over practicality, usually only seen in the houses of the wealthy elite. Including poster beds, royal chairs, tables and armchairs.
Learn to build furniture of the modern day that is focused on practicality over beauty, such as roulette tables, wardrobes, dart boards, punching bags and ergonomic beds.
Learn to build trash bins, small containers that hold trash until it can be hauled away.
Learn how to sculpt tall, narrow shaped obelisks to commemorate important events.
Learn how to create beautiful vases and other vessels from simple materials.
Master the techniques of wall carving to create beautiful pillars and reliefs.
Create beautiful ways to display artifacts and important colony goods.
Sculpt accurate character-shaped sculptures, inscribed with artistic illustrations.
Create massive monuments, centerpieces of your colony, to commemorate those who passed and give inspiration to those still struggling.
Learn how to create beautiful rugs to decorate your colony.
Construct beautiful walls covered in wallpaper of your desired colour.
Adapt advanced display techniques to showcase three-dimensional models around your colony.

A new step in entertainment technology. Via a complex array of lenses, focused light and a little dosage of clever engineering, ethereal images illuminate and enrich every environment.
As a true staple of every spacer-tech colony. It allows for the projection of various images, media and audio information in ways never before seen.
They even offer various usages, when it comes to passive entertainment, education, or a slight bit of propaganda, now and then.
Learn to construct artificial ecosystems, highly advanced terraria which vastly improve upon hydroponics.
Assemble schematics for a device which can automatically water fields, increasing the speed at which crops grow.
Build a primitive humanoid figure capable of scaring off small animals.
Build advanced furniture usually only seen in advanced colonies and glitterworld buildings.
Build advanced electronics usually only seen in advanced colonies and glitterworld buildings.
Build doors that use advanced technology to provide strong protection.
Craft gas-operated heavy machine guns built for sustained heavy-caliber fire against armored targets and groups.

Craft electromagnetic sidearms that launch armor-piercing sabots at extreme velocity.
Craft compact unstable beam weapons from advanced components and improvised battery cells.

Components recovered from sophisticated equipment can be adapted into powerful additions to artificial body parts.

Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module is equipped with a retractable, flexible and razor-sharp mantis-like blade. Can be adjusted to fit a variety of fighting styles.

It has been enhanced using mono weapon components, resulting in combat performance and effectiveness comparable to that of a monosword.

Manufacture an advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in handling anomalous objects and act as a digital encyclopedia on that particular subject. The subpersona can alter its user's brain chemistry on the fly, shielding them from certain types of harmful or disorienting psychic phenomena that can impede the process of containing or studying anomalous material.

A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.

Interchangeable devices expand the functions of artificial body parts, allowing a replacement limb or organ to support specialized upgrades.

Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial leg replacement. The module is equipped with several storage compartments, automatic harnesses and special magnets that allow the user to carry more objects at the same time. It does not affect the amount of weight its host is capable of lifting.

Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed onto a kidney or any compatible artificial kidney replacement. The module utilizes specialized mechanites and advanced filtration systems specifically engineered to detect and combat the influenza virus, granting complete immunity to it. It is largely ineffective against other diseases and infections.

Compact chemical systems let implanted modules produce, store and release useful or weaponized substances.

Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module is capable of ejecting a burst of firefoam through vent-like openings. Syncing with other modules of the same kind allows it to work with greater efficiency.

Embedded artificial assistants supplement the brain with specialized knowledge and task-specific processing.

Manufacture an advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in research tasks and act as a digital encyclopedia on that and any similar subject. The subpersona can quickly and accurately analyze devices, substances and documents while also being able to perform complex calculations in fractions of a second.

A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.
Enhance animal implants and bionics with various modules.

Refined artificial anatomy builds on standard bionics to improve the performance of limbs and other replacement parts.

Manufacture an ultra advanced artificial arm, further improved from the standard models. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage. It is better than a biological arm in almost every way.

Engineered tissues and miniature control systems reproduce internal organ functions with performance beyond basic prostheses.

Manufacture an advanced artificial heart. It has synthetic muscle fibers for a realistic heartbeat, plus a high-flow pump for rapid circulation during high stress. It is better than a biological heart in almost every way.

projects.ds: Manufacture a compact agricultural hand replacement with telescoping tools that sow several holes or harvest multiple points at once. A general-purpose manipulator handles other tasks, and the assembly folds away to avoid the movement penalty of the older design.

Manufacture a razor-sharp talon which extends from a hidden opening between the middle and ring fingers. The talon is longer than the palm, but it becomes flexible upon retracting, allowing the user to curl it up and conceal it inside the palm of the bionic hand.

This weapon system have been integrated into a bionic hand, at a small cost to the efficiency of the original bionic hand. No longer needing to be careful in not injuring the user's biological hand, the hand talons are now sharper than ever.
Manufacture an enhanced liver augmented with synthetic fibres to decrease rejection rate. Upgraded further by integrating the detoxifier enhancer implant into it.
Build warcasket foundries to manufacture basic warcasket parts and outfit pawns to utilise said warcaskets.
Construct balanced advanced warcaskets with improved protection and dependable mobility.
Construct aerodynamic warcaskets fitted with rocket boosters for rapid aerial deployment.
Build spacer warcaskets: siegebreaker, guardian, brute, controller and sarcophagus, and with their mods the eventide, sovereign, medic and shipcracker warcaskets.
Unlocks the operation “remove warcasket” to remove a pawn from a warcasket, losing both their arms and legs, and reducing the warcasket to slag.
Build upscaled automatic rifles designed for warcasket operators.
Utilise new spacer technologies to create upscaled weapons designed to be mounted on warcaskets.
Craft suits which combine alcohol distillation and nutrient paste synthesis to produce rum from recycled human waste.
Develop advanced biotechnologies to create highly customizable synthetic bodies called sleeves for use with neural stacks.

Manufacture an ultratech neural implant which can store a human consciousness, commonly referred to as a neural. Once implanted directly into a person's spine in the neck it will download their consciousness and safely store it. While the death of an organic or inorganic body is no longer a concern, being a fragile piece of technology, blunt force trauma and bullets to the neck area should be avoided at all cost.

Extremely rare, heavily restricted and hard to produce, these implants are rare on non-ultratech worlds.
Continue to advance neural technologies to facilitate the manipulation and replication of digitised human consciousness.
Research the ability to project a digitised consciousness by integrating psychic subwaves with short-range, high-speed communication frequencies.

Leverage neural technologies and a blend of torturous virtual realities to program skilltrainers from living individuals. A person's mind will be forced to complete a multitude of skill-related tasks over and over, creating artificial neural patterns that will be transferred to the skilltrainer's mechanites.
text.todo.
Craft chrysalis armor, specialised for a wide range of different battlefield scenarios and needs, while providing the most protection possible. Note that this also requires advanced components.
Develop advanced shield gear that supports the use of ranged weapons and incorporates implantable shield auras.

Manufacture a nano-mesh controlled by a visual/tactile neural interface. It allows for dynamic adaptations of the user's vocal cord to adapt their voice to a more attractive or dominant tone, enhancing their ability to speak.

Manufacture a non-intelligent microcomputer monitoring the user's emotional state passively. If a mental break is detected, it will cause a split second state of unconsciousness to prevent it. While effective, the technology is imperfect and has a low risk of damaging the user’s brain

Manufacture a near-intelligent microcomputer which automatically analyses new memories when the user is asleep. It will boost positive memories, making them last longer, while trying to suppress negative ones. As a positive side effect the user's will always experience pleasant dreams.

Manufacture an advanced artificial combat focused arm. Razor-sharp, retractable and powered by silenced nano-motors which replace the radius and ulna. When extended the blade allows for devastating attacks, offering unparalleled swiftness and precision. When retracted neuromuscular synchronisation makes them appear and function like a normal arm.
Build weapons that utilize eltex capacitors and lenses to grow more powerful the higher the psy-sensittivity of their wielder and their target.
Craft compact sidearms that fire explosive impact-tip cartridges for close-range stopping power.
Build crusader armor, a super-heavy ancient-pattern powered armor suit used across the known galaxy for its reliability and durability. Note that these also require advanced components.
Assemble crude handguns from scavenged parts, loose tolerances, and barely reliable firing mechanisms.
Craft reinforced batons with electrical contact prods for close-range incapacitation.
Craft fully automatic sidearms built from lightweight alloys for nearly instantaneous deployment.
Craft dependable short-barreled sidearms suited to close and medium-range frontier fighting.
Craft reliable sidearms that focus Empire-derived technology into coherent armor-piercing beams.
Learn to sow Forsaken plants.
Produce razor, a synthetic combat-enhancing drug developed by Forsakens to counter their weaknesses in combat.
Build a small primitive device capable of grinding harvested product into fine grains.

projects.ds: Build a bench capable of packaging smaller amounts of harvested product into usable seed bundles.
Grow the first hive structures: creepers, glow pods, deep heaters, jelly farms and thornspitters, along with hive walls, hive doors, hivestone walls and insect jelly walls.
Grow specialised pods: large glow pods, firefoam pods, heat pods, staticpods and thorn pods, plus freeze pods when the black hive is present.
Grow jellyspreaders and royal jellyspreaders that turn creep into insect jelly and royal jelly terrain, and tendril farms that seed creep with tendrilmoss.
Build fire-resistant burrow walls and royal jelly walls, plus black jelly walls when the black hive is present.
Build artificial hives that spawn Kemian, Nuchadus and Xanides geneline insectoids, plus black hive insectoids when the black hive is present.
Grow jelly morphers that refine insect jelly into royal insect jelly, plus black jelly morphers when the black hive is present.
Raise vilelobber mounds that spit corrosive acid, plus black defilers and bio mech disruptors when the black hive is present.
Grow hivenodes that sustain nearby insectoid structures and petroglyphers that turn rock into hivestone, plus black creepers and foam belchers when the black hive is present.
Grow dense glow pod formations and towering glow pod spires bright enough to grow crops.
Begin exploring the potential in extracting genetic material from creatures. Sample genoframes from wildlife and genes from your colonists for use in genetic alteration.
Create new animal hybrids with the Genomorpher, gestate them in an Animal Electrowomb and create boosters at the Bestiagenics Tinkering Table.
Manufacture Template Genomes through the Genome Recombinator and duplicate existing Genomes.

Bioengineered grafts adapt useful traits from other species to the anatomy of animals and hybrids.

Manufacture a renal implant that uses avian genes to improve the host organ's function.

Hybrid tissues make selected animal traits compatible with the human body.

Manufacture an enlarged auditory implant using leporid anatomy to greatly improve hearing.
Create Biomechanical Lab beacons to find mechahybridizers, and construct mechahybrid antennas to support more mechanoid hybrids.
Acquire disease samples from sick colonists to initiate a production chain of powerful pathogens.
Craft flesh-breaker chemical gas grenade launchers, explosive barrels and devastating mortar shells.
Craft flu virus gas grenade launchers, explosive barrels and devastating mortar shells.
Craft malaria parasite gas grenade launchers, explosive barrels and devastating mortar shells.

Craft necroa archovirus pythogen gas grenade launchers, explosive gas barrels and devastating mortar shells. This archovirus turns creatures into shamblers post-mortem. Shamblers raised by necroa gas are not affiliated with any faction.\n\nNecroa archovirus can be sampled from shamblers or creatures infected with necroa.
Craft plague bacteria gas grenade launchers, explosive barrels and devastating mortar shells.
Craft scaria virus gas grenade launchers, explosive barrels and devastating mortar shells.
Craft sleeping sickness parasite gas grenade launchers, explosive barrels and devastating mortar shells.
Study the fundamental principles of the immune system. Develop techniques to culture weakened pathogens and stimulate preventive immune responses. Unlocks wound infection vaccine.
Expand vaccine research to cover malaria, a parasite common in tropical and jungle biomes. Unlocks malaria vaccine.
Study viruses that turn animals and pawns into feral, aggressive threats. Unlocks scaria vaccine.

Apply immunological principles to veterinary medicine. Develop vaccines specially formulated for animal physiology to protect your livestock and pets from deadly diseases. Unlocks animal vaccines for scaria, plague, and flu.

Push vaccine technology to its limit using nano-scale engineering. Program nanobots to identify and neutralize specific pathogens almost instantly, providing near-total protection. Unlocks nano-vaccines for all diseases.

Develop an understanding of the mechanite organisms that infest human bodies. Engineer counter-nanobot swarms capable of detecting, deactivating, and reprogramming hostile mechanites. Unlocks nano-shields and nano-neutralisers for fibrous and sensory mechanites.
Manufacture pills that treat addiction to psychite, go-juice, wake-up, smokeleaf and ambrosia.
Manufacture vaccines against common and deadly diseases.
Manufacture clozapine, morphine and penicillin.
Refine crimson bulb and other crops into heroin, joy, thornweed serum and tyrox.
Prepare opium, peyote and thornweed infusions and smelling salts.
Produce a synthetic combat-enhancing drug that reduces pain while slightly increasing consciousness, breathing, and manipulation.
Make beard wax, miner's delight and redspice.
Roll cigarettes and cigars.
Develop a method for producing antibiotics that boost the immune system after infections take hold.
Manufacture flake and other cheap, powerful and exceptionally addictive drugs.
Prepare smokeleaf joints, chewing smokeleaf and other smokeables.
Brew herbal extracts, elixirs, powders and draughts through alchemy.
Refine sivadust ivory and brew remedies and scents from the parts of great beasts.

Genetrainer repurposing unlocks the jury rigging of mech serum neurotrainers, healers, psytrainers and resurrectors to craft genetrainers, single use artifacts that inject animal genetic material in a human being, acting as a powerful implant that doesn't take the place of any organ in the body.

projects.ds: Build a machine that can seperate genepacks, at the potential cost of losing all contained genes instead.
Build a machine that can duplicate xenogerms, even with archite genes given the right amount of material.
Construct advanced gravship weaponry, warpods and targeting consoles, as well as gravship bombardment targeters.
Reinforce the gravship by constructing gravship armor and subarmor, new compact turrets and gravmines, as well as gravship shield generators, making it much more resistant to enemy fire.
Construct various buildings and apparel that improve the comfort and security of living in harsh vacuum of space.
Build linkable fish tanks to store fish.
Build a device that goes inside of a fish tank to maintain the temperature for small networks.
Build an external tank device that allows control of water temperature in larger fish tank networks.
Build a basic rotating chamber that is placed on the edge of a tank to automatically feed fish in smaller networks.
Build an external utility that autonomously crafts and stores food to dispense it into large tank networks regularly.
Build a small building that is placed inside of a fish tank to reduce hygiene decay in its tank network.
Build a device that regularly cleans large tank networks while draining large amounts of power.
Create weapons, apparel and walls inspired by the majesty of nature.
projects.s: Roo's Satyr and Faun Xenotypes Expanded

projects.ds: Learn how to produce black powder and smoke bombs.
Craft the Tanegashima matchlock guns, a hard hitting set of guns with good stopping power.
Craft the hand mortar, a long range siege weapon used to set the enemy on fire.
Craft the yumi, a great bow with good accuracy.
Build ninja gear like the ninja mask, ninja tools, and shuriken.
Build simple sets of ashigaru armor and helmets.
Build suits of samurai armor and samurai helmets. A more elaborate daimyo quality helmets and armors can also be built.
Forge the naginata and omi yari. More advanced polearms with armor penetration or longer range.
Learn the art of katana smithing. Elegant blades with a sharp and hard edge.
Learn how to turn rice to to delicious sake. Moromi creation can be done at the brewery station.
Build a calligraphy set, a recreation item for the artistic kind.
Sow the cherry blossom tree to bring beauty to your lands.
Learn the way of the samurai.
Craft powered armors and gear used by the powerful Zaibatsu spacer conglomerates. Note that these items will require advanced components.
Begin researching vehicle production, beginning with a simple off-road vehicle.

Build trucks for hauling cargo: basic small trucks that carry a lot over long distances on paved roads, and fast pickup trucks with high cargo capacity and great fuel efficiency on the world map. Both struggle on hills, snow or winter.

Build a small airplane that moves extremely fast and can carry more cargo than an helicopter, but requires a landing strip. It is very visible, like any aircraft. It has a regular fuel efficiency on the world map, but makes up for it in speed.
Build the Bulldog, a medium tank with solid armor and good performance on rough terrain.
Establish a connection to a radio-based extensive warrant network where factions place bounties on individuals and artifacts across the planet.
Build manipulator beam emitters that move items with manipulator beams, operated from a console or automated.
