projects.ds: Build shelves, pallets, racks, baskets and other simple storage.
Build wooden crates, barrels, chests, strongboxes and meat hooks to store resources.
Build stylish fast cars: vintage cars that lift their passengers' mood, and supercars that move incredibly fast on flat roads. Both struggle on hills and in the cold.
Learn to build heavily armored battle tanks such as the marshal, equipped with a variety of weapons. In order to research this project, a marshal wreck needs to be found and restored.
Build military vehicles: assault carriers and armored scouts that carry troops, a missile artillery truck, a self-propelled gun for long-range firepower, and an armored military helicopter.

Build heavy-duty civilian vehicles: versatile off-road jeeps with light armor, big freight trucks that carry people and cargo over long distances, and refrigerated trucks that keep perishable goods from spoiling.

Learn to build a dual-rotor cargo helicopter called cherokee, capable of delivering thousands of kilograms of resources via air routes. In order to research this project, a cherokee wreck needs to be found and restored.
Learn to build powerful siege pods that act as temporary, moving bases during assaults in enemy territory. In order to research this project, a goliath wreck needs to be found and restored.
Build an expandable raft made of pieces. The first invention that enabled humanity to cross the ocean.
Build a ship's hull using early technology. It's narrow but reasonably sturdy.
Build a massive, robust ship's hull. It is reinforced with iron. It will surely prove its worth in battle.
Build a comfortable boat with excellent space efficiency. Additional decks can be added. It is, in a sense, a raft built with advanced technology.
Learn culinary techniques to treat and prep pungent marine meats such as shark and kraken flesh to make them palatable and safe to eat.
Learn how to render down rich fats and tissues from shark and kraken meat at a biofuel refinery to produce chemfuel.
Tailor practical maritime apparel designed for life at sea, including nautical shirts, pants, sailor and pirate hats, as well as wearable floats for swimming safely in deep waters.
Learn technologies useful for melee combat on ships.
Learn to increase the buoyancy of rafts.
Build a single-sail rig to increase a ship's speed.
Learn to build advanced multi-tiered masts and complex sail rigs to dramatically increase the cruising speed of your ships.
Learn to manufacture electrically powered outboard motors for watercraft, trading electrical power for steady and rapid propulsion regardless of wind.
Learn to cast and assemble black powder naval cannons to arm watercraft with devastating heavy firepower against enemy vessels and threats.
Learn to build dumpsters, large sealed containers that store a lot of trash.
Construct simple lens arrays to solidify photons into tight beams that burn flesh. Note that these need jade.
Crude torture involves generally unskilled mutilation and medieval implements of torture.
Medical torture entails more advanced torture and research methods, generally requiring a skilled doctor to perform.
Details the fabrication and implantation of relatively crude cybernetics that destabilize organs, causing long-term pain and suffering.
While butchering humanoids for meat has been a long standing practice of cannibals, methods exist that allow the growing and harvesting of meat and fungi in humanoid patients without killing them.
Knowledge of advanced medical torture including lobotomization and cruel brain implants.
Horrific knowledge of how to incubate neutroamine in a person's body for continuous cultivation.
Build cages and wall-mounted cots for confining captives.
Build restraint chairs, racks, poles, crosses, X-frames, pillories and guillotines for holding captives.
Build a powered restraint chair for electrocuting captives.
Build punching bags, training dummies and archery targets to train melee and shooting skills.
Organize the earliest classrooms with class chimes, lesson stones, and rough desks.
Build blackboards, school desks and school bells to hold classes.
Produce marker-friendly classroom boards that are cleaner and clearer than chalk boards.
Build safe target stations and training rifles for structured firearm classes.
Build projectors and electric school bells for powered classrooms.
Build holo-educator screens and touchscreen school desks.
Gestate berserker, bombardier, constrictor, infiltrator and templar mechanoids.

Build a mechlink upgrade which allows the mechanitor to interface with a mechanoid to boost its performance and reduce incoming damage. The user psychically links with their target, using their own brain as a backup for critical subsystems.
Gestate the cicada, demolisher and enforcer war machines.
Gestate conqueror infantry mechanoids armed with blasters, carbines or spitters.
Build a reinforced fixed laser emplacement around a salvaged gazer ocular emitter. When manually aimed within its frontal firing arc, it releases a devastating sun ray beam at extreme power cost.
Gestate the haze, lasher and pulse combat mechanoids.
Gestate the frostivus, tinker and vassal support mechanoids.
Build mech repair stations, stasis chambers, gestator amplifiers and purifier stations.
Manufacture a plasma whip inspired by the Lasher mechanoid's weapon. It can damage and stun multiple targets at once, making it useful for holding back enemies at close range.
Build a powered station that repairs large mechanoids. The mechanoid enters the station to undergo repairs.
Gestate the celerus, dominus and terminus commander mechanoids.
Craft the skipblade, dominion psy-spear and severing blade from commander mechanoid technology.
Gestate the javelin and siren mechanoids.
Gestate the aegis, dynamo, mantis and maul heavy mechanoids.
Gestate the gazer, ravager and ingestor ultra-heavy mechanoids.
Manufacture a reinforced gamma-ray emitter that produces a dense, destructive energy ball which discharges into nearby targets and ignites its surroundings.
Manufacture a mechmancer suit and matching helmet, power-assisted mechanitor armor that greatly expands bandwidth while providing serious protection.
Manufacture a mechmancer pack, an advanced bandwidth-expansion utility pack that can deploy independent satellite mechanoids.
Build devices that boost the efficiency, protection and targeting of nearby friendly mechs.
Build the mech disruptor and persistent mech booster.
Manufacture a heavy power armor helmet packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mech master helmet drastically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, while being as protective as a marine helmet.
Build a remote mech disruption device. Any enemy mechanoids in its effect radius will have reduced agility, movement and targeting skill.

Manufacture a backpack containing a voidlink relay to access the vast amounts of data present on this system's mechanoid voidlink network. It can vastly increase a mechanitor's maximum total bandwidth.
Summon the apoptosis and infernus mechanoids.
Assemble battle and turret drones.
Assemble hauler, miner and broadcaster drones.
Manufacture headsets, packs and implants that extend a mechanitor's bandwidth, control groups and gestation speed.
Manufacture array headsets, bandwidth packs, band nodes and high control sublinks.
Manufacture integrator headsets and mechcommander helmets.
Build a remote energy and computation enhancement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will move and work faster.
Manufacture mechlink upgrades that let a mechanitor repair and shield mechs from a distance.
Manufacture the mechlord suit and repair probe.
Gestate ultra-tier combat mechanoids such as the legionary, tesseron and war queen.
Build an extinguisher drone trap that launches a firefoam drone when it detects nearby flames.
Build traps that release hunter drones and wasp drones when enemies come near.
Manufacture hunter packs armed with EMP, incendiary, smoke, toxic and antigrain warheads.
Build a wearable pack that deploys a hunter drone.
Gestate heavy and ultra-heavy combat mechanoids.
Gestate medium combat mechanoids that fight up close.
Gestate mechanoids built for mining, drilling and hauling.
Gestate advanced worker mechanoids for crafting and medical care.
Gestate medium combat mechanoids that fight from range.
Gestate mechanoids that care for children, serve customers and tend to the colony's daily needs.
Perform psychic rituals that alter the genetics of hosts.

Build a self-contained mobile dwelling, designed for a portable life on the rim. Can be entered like a structure, offering a compact interior with space to rest, store supplies, and shelter from the elements. Though cramped it provides a novel luxury, a home that moves with you. Ideal for a nomadic lifestyle.
Build a large truck meant to deliver troops and supplies away from the base. It can move well in rough terrain, but the fuel efficiency is low, and passengers in the back will lack protection.

Build a small tank with light armor. It's very cheap and easy to assemble, but very loud and vulnerable in the rear. They aren't very fast or accurate and use a lot of fuel, and are best used in short-range engagements.

Build a heavy-duty truck with a vast building platform on its bed, perfect for mounting weapons or transporting large amounts of equipment or other vehicles. It has excellent cargo capacity but is less fuel-efficient.
Build a behemoth moving platform, capable of sustaining a entire civilization on its surface.
Build mast-mounted lookouts to spot islands and shipwrecks.
Build gangplanks to cross between boats.
Build grappling launchers to move between boats using mooring rings.

Build improvised armed vehicles: a light flame tank with fireproof plating and chemfuel tanks that burns enemies and fortifications, and a farm tractor repurposed to carry a rack of explosive rockets. Neither is fuel-efficient on the world map.

Build fast aircraft: a small helicopter that carries more cargo than an off-roader but needs a landing pad, and a fighter plane with minimal cargo capacity, made to engage other aircraft. Aircraft are very easy to notice.
Build heavy work vehicles: flatbed cargo trucks for hauling bulk supplies, and slow, noisy snowcrawlers that cross snow and winter terrain without trouble.

Build vehicles that carry many people: minivans and vans with high passenger space, and, with the right mods, passenger buses and light utility jeeps. They do best on paved roads and struggle in hills, snow and winter.
Assemble heavy engines and jet engines.

Build motorbikes for a single rider: dirt bikes that cross any terrain but carry no cargo, and motorcycles that carry a little cargo and are fuel-efficient on the world map. Both struggle in snow and winter.

Build motorized boats: small boats with good cargo capacity but high fuel use, and larger vessels with high cargo capacity, good fuel efficiency and low visibility. Boats have trouble with winter and river currents.

Build automobiles: makeshift cars that are fast but carry only a couple of people, and all-purpose passenger cars with good passenger and cargo capacity and high fuel efficiency. Cars do best on smooth roads.

Build armored vehicles for troops: lightly armored cars that provide mobile fire support, and armored personnel carriers with hardened armor, good cargo capacity and all-terrain support. Both are weaker in the rear.

Build reusable pods: rocket pods fitted with thrusters that move much faster than transport pods, and heavily armored siege pods with a siege gun on top that work as deployable bunkers. Both use a lot of fuel.
Manage resources and traversal of platform vehicles, and build improvement modules for them.
Craft grenade launchers that disperse weaponized pathogens and chemical agents over groups of enemies. Each launcher also needs research into its own pathogen.

Install glitterworld-grade brain and eye implants. Covers, depending on your mods: auxiliary AI (combat), auxiliary AI (worker) and tactical bionic eye.
Install signal boosters that extend a mechanitor's bandwidth. Covers, depending on your mods: signal booster (standard) and signal booster (high).

Install ultratech implants that give a mechanitor command over mechanoids. Covers, depending on your mods: cerebrex node implant, remote resurrector, warprogrammer interface, signal booster (ultra), mechwomb and remote dominator.
Install an implant that speeds up a mechanitor's mech gestation. Covers, depending on your mods: mech gestation processor.

Fit modular bionics with melee weapons. Covers, depending on your mods: elbow blade module, hand talon module, knee spike module, power blade module, power claw module, power fang module, power fist module, power kick module, power saw module, powerslash horn module, powerstrike horn module, venom fangs module, venom talon module and brawler lens combat module.

Fit modular bionics with built-in guns and launchers. Covers, depending on your mods: assault rifle module, autopistol module, chain shotgun module, charge lance module, charge rifle module, heavy SMG module, LMG module, minigun module, pump shotgun module, sniper rifle module, doomsday rocket launcher module, EMP launcher module, incendiary launcher module, smoke launcher module, toxbomb launcher module and ranger lens combat module.

Fit modular bionics with grenade throwers and trap deployers. Covers, depending on your mods: frag grenade module, EMP grenade module, tox grenade module, antigrain trap deployer module, deadlife trap deployer module, EMP trap deployer module, explosive trap deployer module, firefoam trap deployer module, incendiary trap deployer module, smoke trap deployer module, tox trap deployer module and EMP burst module.

Fit modular bionics with deployable turrets, drones and shields. Covers, depending on your mods: turret deployer module, hunter drone deployer module, low-shield deployer module, mini-turret gravdrone module and crypto turret gravdrone module.
Fit modular bionics with field projectors. Covers, depending on your mods: cryoprojector module, magprojector module, medprojector module, pyroprojector module and radprojector module.
Fit modular bionics with jump packs and hover systems. Covers, depending on your mods: jump pack module, nuclear jump pack module, leap module and hover module.

Fit modular bionics with tools for everyday work. Covers, depending on your mods: analyzer module, chef module, constructor module, crafter module, drill module, field module, medic module, mindreader module, faunamaster module, gastro-analyzer module, mechanalyzer module and mechsensor module.

Fit modular bionics with utility functions. Covers, depending on your mods: aesthetic module, airwire module, atmofilter module, biowelder module, coagulator module, cooler module, detoxifier module, devourer module, echolocation module, flashlight module, gastrosterilizer module, heater module, hemofilter module, immunoenhancer module, mecharray module, reprocessor module, silence module, tunenode module, vacbreath module and voicemod module.
Fit modular bionics with their own power sources. Covers, depending on your mods: atompower module, chempower module and nuclear module.

Fit modular bionics with synthesizers that produce drugs and fuel. Covers, depending on your mods: alcohol synthesizer module, go-juice synthesizer module, psychite synthesizer module, smokeleaf synthesizer module, wake-up synthesizer module, fuelmaker module, hemomaker module and fertility adjuster module.

Fit modular bionics with uplinks that call down orbital strikes. Covers, depending on your mods: orbital bombardment module, orbital mech cluster module, orbital power beam module and tornado generator module.

Fit modular bionics with chemical bursts, spewers and weaves. Covers, depending on your mods: high-explosive burst module, incendiary burst module, smoke burst module, smoke spewer module, tox burst module, tox spewer module, cryoweave module, magweave module, pyroweave module and toxweave module.

Install auxiliary subpersona chips that take over specialized work. Covers, depending on your mods: assembler subpersona, botanist subpersona, brawler subpersona, chef subpersona, constructor subpersona, mechlord subpersona, miner subpersona, psywielder subpersona, ranger subpersona, socialite subpersona, surgeon subpersona and zoologist subpersona.

Fit modular bionics with mono, plasma and zeus weapons. Covers, depending on your mods: monofang module, monosaw module, monoslash horn module, plasmablade module, plasmafang module, plasmasaw module, plasmaslash horn module, zeusfang module, zeusfist module, zeuskick module and zeustrike horn module.
Fit modular bionics with dark archotech abilities. Covers, depending on your mods: deadlife burst module, deadlife spewer module, disruptor flare module and revenant vertebrae module.

Fit animal bionics with strike and tail modules. Covers, depending on your mods: cryostrike module, magstrike module, monoslash tail module, plasmaslash tail module, powerslash tail module, powerstrike tail module, pyrostrike module, venomstrike module and zeustrike tail module.
Fit animal bionics with modules that produce leather and meat. Covers, depending on your mods: leathermaker module and meatmaker module.

Fit modular bionic arms with weapons and grips. Covers, depending on your mods: arm dart gun module, arm gauss lance module, arm shotgun module, arm SMG module, death grip module, recoil suppression module and vibro-module.

Fit modular bionic eyes and jaws with new functions. Covers, depending on your mods: eye colour module, night vision module, protective lens module, targeting module, telescopic sight module, gourmand tongue module and hemo-fangs module.
Fit modular bionic legs and lungs with new functions. Covers, depending on your mods: digitigrade module, foot blade module, retractable flipper module, venom foot blade module and rebreather module.

Manufacture bionic replacements for animal body parts. Covers, depending on your mods: animal bionic beak, animal bionic blade, animal bionic ear, animal bionic eye, animal bionic gas bag, animal bionic heart, animal bionic horn, animal bionic jaw, animal detoxifier kidney, animal bionic leg, animal detoxifier liver, animal detoxifier lung, animal bionic nose, animal bionic shell, animal bionic spine, animal bionic stinger, animal bionic stomach, animal bionic tail, animal bionic tentacle and animal bionic wing.

Give animals bionic implants that improve their bodies. Covers, depending on your mods: animal circadian supercharger, animal dermal armor gland, animal healclot synergizer, animal immunoenhancer, animal nuclear stomach and animal unstable skip synapsis.
Graft mutated flesh weapons onto animals. Covers, depending on your mods: animal eldritch flesh tentacle, animal pseudo deadlife shaper, animal ranged trispikes and animal toughspikes.

Program chips that teach animals new work. Covers, depending on your mods: animal work chip: clean, animal work chip: feed patient, animal work chip: flick, animal work chip: harvest, animal work chip: hunting, animal work chip: mine, animal work chip: slaughter and animal work chip: sow.

Give animals implanted breath, spit and spine weapons. Covers, depending on your mods: animal acid spray, animal acidic breath, animal acidic spitter, animal barbed quill thrower, animal bioelectric organ, animal fire breath, animal fire spray, animal foam spray, animal toxic breath, animal venomous spitter, animal wisp fire, animal quad tesla cannon, animal ranged spinneret, animal petrifying gaze, animal piercing spine, animal light focusing lens and animal goo acidifier.

Give animals implants that change their size and body. Covers, depending on your mods: animal enlarger implant, animal shrinker implant, animal stealthskin implant, animal hyper acidic stomach, animal healy power and animal extra gas bag.
u: animal Upsy Daisy vampirey healy power

projects.ds: Graft animal-derived genetic implants into people. Covers, depending on your mods: bear claws, bear muscle tissue, boomalope nodules, cat eye, chemfuel heart, chemfuel stomach, compound insectoid eye, devouring jaws, digging mole claws, hibernation module, iguana scales, insectoid receptor, kidney toxic filters, mole-rat nerve dampener, mouse pheromones, muffalo mammaries, muffalo skin, muffalo strengthened muscles, neuron reinforcement, ovipositor, psychic dampeners, thrumbo horn, thrumbo skin, venomous fangs and wolf muscular fibers.

Graft genetic implants from other species into animals. Covers, depending on your mods: animal bear leg, animal bear liver, animal bionic thrumbo brain, animal bionic thrumbo eye, animal bionic thrumbo jaws, animal boomalope heart, animal boomalope stomach, animal canid eye, animal cat tail, animal chicken brains, animal chitinous heart, animal crocodile spine, animal elephant auditory receptor, animal elephant leg, animal insect mandibles, animal insectile eye, animal insectoid pheromones, animal lizard leg, animal miniature thrumbo horn, animal monitor lizard brain, animal moth tympanal organ, animal muffalo lung, animal muffalo spine, animal reinforced bionic heart, animal reinforced bionic spine, animal reinforced tail, animal rodent ear, animal rodent nose, animal scyther tail and animal wolf fangs.

Manufacture the artificial parts androids are built from. Covers, depending on your mods: android arm, android foot, android hand, android leg, artificial jaw, artificial nose, artificial ribcage, artificial spine, air filter, audio processor, metabolism regulator, neuropump, neutrofilter, optical unit and reactor.

Write exec data programs for hacking. Covers, depending on your mods: exec data (disarm), exec data (discharge), exec data (fork bomb), exec data (hijack subcore), exec data (short circuit), exec data (virtual black ICE breaker) and exec data (zapcode).

Manufacture a bionic module that allows the user to extend a compact flamethrower from their forearm. An internal pump slowly but autonomously refills the weapon.

Modules can be self-installed into modified bionic or archotech parts, but can only be ejected by removing the part.

Manufacture a bionic module that allows the user to extend retractable cryogenic-coated claws. On impact, they inflicts deep frostburns, flash-freezing flesh and lacing wounds with cryptofreeze, slowing movement and dealing substantial hypothermic damage over time.

Modules can be self-installed into modified bionic or archotech parts, but can only be ejected by removing the part.

Manufacture an artificial arm for animals. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage. It is better than a biological arm in almost every way.

Manufacture a mechanical replacement arm for animals. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real arm.
Manufacture an animal mind controller implant. This implant will allow this creature to be drafted and controlled by the player.

projects.ds: Manufacture a combat-oriented arm replacement consisting of a mechanical hand with a hooked claw on each finger. It cuts deep, and it is strong enough to crush a skull like a hand crushes an egg. The claws can be retracted, making it as useful as a natural hand for non-combat tasks.

projects.ds: Begin building structures capable of holding wild animals.
Build a stone-lined cesspit that collects sewage and slowly treats it. Holds 500 L and treats 50 L per day. When full, excess sewage is sent to sewage outlets.

Build the basics of hygiene without plumbing: pit latrines, burn pits for fecal sludge, water wells for manual collection, water tubs for washing and drinking, bath mats, stall doors, and litter boxes, troughs and bowls for animals.

Supply plumbed fixtures with water: wind pumps, groundwater and surface water intakes, water butts, tanks and towers, and valves that open or close connections between pipes. Stored water must be drained if it becomes contaminated.
Build basic plumbed fixtures: basins for washing hands after using the toilet, bathtubs for a comfortable, leisurely wash, and sewage outlets where sewage pools and slowly cleans up.
Build showers and shower stalls that use water supplied by water towers. They can be heated via plumbed hot water tanks and do not require a sewage outlet.\n65L per wash
Build kitchen sinks that increase room cleanliness and water fountains used for drinking and washing.
Build large stores of water for plumbed fixtures: huge water towers and, with DBH Expanded, large water tanks and large hot water tanks. Stored water must be drained if it becomes contaminated.
Build gas coolers for cold rooms using helixien gas.
Build gas heaters for warm rooms using helixien gas.
Build chemfuel heaters for warm rooms without relying on the power grid.
Learn how to construct a simple tub shaped watercraft powered by a paddle.
Craft simple garments from leaves and plant fibers.

Manufacture a glittertech heart replacement that renders the user’s blood mutated and fire‑immune. It protects all body cells and the skin from ignition, but it also lowers antibody counts and compromises the immune system, reducing blood filtration efficiency.

While it can save lives during short-term fire exposure, it becomes highly unstable and harmful after prolonged extreme temperatures exposure.

projects.ds: Prepare psychoid leaves into a mildly euphoria-inducing and addictive tea at the campfire or cooking stove.
Sow the local biome's natural trees in your fields.
Build a brewery and fermenting vats to transform hops into tasty, tasty beer.
Build complex furniture like beds, end tables, dining chairs, armchairs, dressers, tool cabinets, billiards tables, and poker tables, vents, sarcophagi, and more.
Make passive coolers, to cool indoor spaces without using electricity.
Cut rock chunks into stone blocks for use in construction. Build beautiful stone tile floors or ugly concrete walkways.
Tailor complicated garments like pants, dusters, and cowboy hats.
Build a drug lab for basic drug synthesis. Further research is required to make specific drugs.
Sow cocoa trees to create your own delicious chocolate. Eating chocolate fulfills the need for recreation and it's a valuable trade good too.
Weave beautiful carpets from cloth.
Make pemmican, a preserved mixture of meat and plant matter that doesn't go bad for a long time. Great for traveling.
Build smithies for crafting metal weapons like knives, gladii, and maces. Work metal into clean, beautiful floor tiles.
Build the recurve bow, an effective and inexpensive ranged weapon.
Refine psychoid leaves into flake and yayo, different forms of the euphoric psychite drug.
Synthesize wake-up, a work performance-enhancing drug which replaces the need for sleep.
Produce go-juice, a synthetic combat-performance-enhancing drug which improves shooting, melee, and movement ability, and dulls pain.
Produce penoxycyline, a disease prevention drug which blocks plague, malaria, and more before they start.
Smith suits of plate armor from metal or wood. This heavy armor noticeably slows movement, but protects very effectively.
Craft greatbows for killing enemies at great range.
Harness the power of electricity for a hundred different tasks.
Build batteries for storing electricity.
Build biofuel refineries to make chemfuel from biological matter like wood or foodstuffs.
Build watermill generators on rivers to generate a steady supply of power.
Build nutrient paste dispensers which efficiently produce edible meals from raw nutritive feedstocks, while requiring no labor at all.
Build solar panels for electricity generation.
Build coolers to make people comfortable in hot weather, or to construct freezers for storing perishable goods.
Build autodoors which automatically open when someone approaches, without slowing anyone down.
Build hydroponics basins to rapidly grow crops indoors regardless of the terrain or weather outside.
Build basic electronic joy sources such as tube televisions, industrial radios, arcades and more.
Produce packaged survival meals which never go bad. Great for traveling.
Construct firefoam poppers, automatic fire-safety devices which spread fire-retardant foam in response to encroaching flames.
Build improvised traps from any kind of mortar shell.
Build geothermal power plants on top of steam geysers, for uninterrupted power.
Construct sterile tiles to make cleanrooms for safer and more effective medical treatment, research, and cooking.
Build powerful outdoors lights. Additionally, customize the color of electric lights and reduce their power consumption by half. This does not affect sun lamps.
Build machining tables to craft guns, grenades, flak armor, and to shred dead mechanoids for resources.
Build smokepop packs which allow the wearer to deploy a defensive smokescreen.

Jointed mechanical substitutes restore basic function to missing limbs without requiring advanced neural interfaces.

Manufacture an arm prosthesis. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real arm.
Craft compact repeating handguns with revolving cylinders and reliable metallic cartridges.
Craft clothing with metal armor sewn in to resist bullets and explosions. This weighty armor slows movement slightly.
Build high-angle launchers that lob explosive rounds over obstacles, and manufacture high-explosive shells for bombardment.
Craft compact self-loading handguns that chamber a fresh cartridge after each shot.
Craft compact automatic weapons that fire powerful wide-caliber rounds in controlled bursts.
Build compact automated gun emplacements that track and fire upon nearby threats.
Produce a turret which can be activated to spray fire-extinguishing foam.
Work with complex microelectronics. This unlocks the hi-tech research bench and comms console.
Build complex electronic joy sources such as flatscreen televisions, longwave radios and more.
Construct moisture pumps, which very slowly normalize the moisture in the ground around them. They can turn wet ground dry and convert soft sand into normal sand.
Construct hospital beds which improve medical outcomes.
Build deep drills for extracting resources from underground. You'll need a ground-penetrating scanner to find the resources.
Build ground-penetrating scanners that can detect drillable resources under the surface. Requires an advanced component to construct.
Construct launchable transport pods that you can use to send people and supplies long distances across the planet's surface. Can be used for raiding, travel, sending gifts, and more.
Produce standard industrial-tech medicine by combining herbal medicine, neutroamine, and cloth.
Construct long-range mineral scanners your researchers can use to detect precious minerals across the planet. Can be tuned to find a specific mineral. Requires advanced components to construct.
Build wearable shield gear. Shields use momentum-repulsion technology to prevent projectiles from traversing the field boundary.
Craft versatile gas-operated rifles with controlled bursts, dependable accuracy, and effective medium-range firepower.
Produce the heavy autocannon turret.
Assemble electrically driven rotary machine guns that deliver a tremendous volume of fire.
Build multi-analyzers which increase research speed and allow higher-level research projects.
Build vitals monitors which improve medical outcomes when placed next to hospital beds.
Build fabrication benches, capable of high-tech projects ranging from component assembly to power armor construction.
Fabricate advanced components from standard components and other materials.
Construct cryptosleep caskets, which can put living beings in a state of indefinite suspended animation.
Craft recon armor, a light powered armor suit used by scout troops who need protection on the move. Note that these also require advanced components.
Build marine armor, a general-use powered armor suit used by high-tech shock troops. Note that these also require advanced components.
Craft burst-fire rifles that energize each projectile with an unstable pulse for exceptional damage and armor penetration.

Powered artificial limbs and sensory organs combine mechanical strength with neural control to replace lost anatomy.

Manufacture an advanced artificial arm. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage. It is better than a biological arm in almost every way.
Produce the armor-penetrating uranium slug turret. It fires uranium slugs which tear through plasteel like paper, but it's less effective at close range.
Produce rocketswarm launchers, single-burst turrets which can devastate a wide area at a key moment in battle.
Construct the structural and supportive elements of a starship. This is the first step in building a ship to leave this star system.
Construct hardened cryptosleep caskets tough enough to be exposed to vacuum, for transporting people on the years-long journey between stars.
Build a long-duration nuclear reactor to power a starship. Note that reactors have a long startup process that will attract raiders.

Construct a Johnson-Tanaka drive for a ship. The JT drive can push you to other stars by leveraging quantum scale effects to beam momentum to distant stars. Of course, as with all starships, it still takes many years to get anywhere.

Build a reward-signal system to persuade an existing persona core into serving as a ship's machine captain. Since people sleep during interstellar travel, a persona core is necessary to handle the complex decisions of a years-long starflight.
Construct long-range sensors for a starship. These sensors are essential for navigation, communication, and threat avoidance.
Tailor noble-specific apparel like formal shirts and top hats.
Tailor royal apparel of the highest tier, like royal robes and crowns.
Craft cataphract armor, heavy powered armor that slows the user but which can absorb extreme punishment. Note that these also require advanced components.
Build jump packs to perform aerial assaults during combat.
Build wearable gunlinks to enhance your soldiers' shooting accuracy.

Manufacture a brain implant which inhibits nociception, or pain sensation. While it does allow the user to accomplish more, it turns out pain has a purpose. When you don't feel it, you can get hurt really bad really easily.

Manufacture a combat-oriented hand replacement consisting of a mechanical hand with a hooked claw on each finger. It cuts deep, and it is strong enough to crush a skull like a hand crushes an egg. The claws can be retracted, making it as useful as a natural hand for non-combat tasks, however its overall ungainliness slows down movement slightly.

Manufacture a razor-sharp talon which extends from a hidden opening between the middle and ring fingers. The talon is longer than the palm, but it becomes flexible upon retracting, allowing the user to curl it up and conceal it inside the hand. It can perform rapid slashing attacks, but is poor at penetrating armor.
Manufacture a pair of injectors implanted through the canine teeth, connected to a venom pump. The user can bite an enemy, extend the injectors, and pump venom into the target.
Manufacture an advanced chemical processing system breaks down nutrients the body could normally never use, leading to increased efficiency.
Manufacture a non-intelligent microcomputer controlled by a visual/tactile neural interface. It assists with memory and calculation, like a calculator and notepad embedded in the brain.
Manufacture an implanted gland that uses chemicals and nanomachines to toughen the skin. It provides modest protection against damage without noticeably changing the host's appearance.
Manufacture an implant that detects blood loss and releases clotting factors, significantly reducing bleeding.
Manufacture a facial prosthesis shaped to the host's preferences and prevalent beauty standards, improving physical impressions.

Manufacture an olfactory implant that detects airborne food compounds through an ultrafine absorption mesh. A processor translates the readings into detailed nerve signals, improving cooking through a heightened sense of smell without changing the host's appearance.
Manufacture an artificial gland that produces chemicals and nanomachines to clear toxin buildup from the brain.
Craft the harp, a simple stationary musical instrument popular among nobility in some cultures.
Craft the harpsichord, a complex stationary musical instrument.
Craft the piano, an advanced stationary musical instrument.
Construct biosculpter pods which can perform various biological alterations to colonists. These are especially important to believers in transhumanism.

Unlock the biosculpter pod's bioregeneration cycle. This cycle heals old scars, regenerates small lost body parts like fingers and toes, and cures many of the physical maladies that come with old age.

Construct neural supercharger devices. Neural superchargers improve consciousness and learning rate, but they also increase hunger and the effect must be refreshed daily. Transhumanists often hold neural supercharging as an important practice.
The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control basic-tier mechanoids.
The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control standard-tier mechanoids.\n\nYou can get signal chips by using a mechanitor to summon a diabolus threat.
The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control high-tier mechanoids.\n\nYou can get powerfocus chips by using a mechanitor to summon a war queen threat.

The advanced technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control ultra-tier mechanoids, including large mechs and ultra-tier mechanitor gear.\n\nYou can get nano structuring chips by using a mechanitor to summon an apocriton threat.
Build wastepack atomizers which can safely dispose of toxic wastepacks by decomposing them at the molecular level.
Create toxifier generators which generate electricity, but also spread pollution around themselves.
Create xenogerms which can be implanted in a person to genetically modify them. Extract genepacks from living people using a gene extractor so you can reimplant their genes into someone else.
Build gene processors, which allow a gene assembler to create xenogerms of higher genetic complexity.
Allows a gene assembler to use archite capsules to create seemingly impossible genes. Archite genes and archite capsules can be obtained from traders.

Those with the deathrest gene must periodically undergo a special deathrest coma that lasts several days. This research project allows you to construct buildings which accelerate the deathrest coma and confer specific bonuses on the deathrester. Over time, you can build a grand deathrest temple.

Perform the surgeries necessary to create a test tube embryo from a fertile man and woman, then implant the embryo in a surrogate mother or growth vat. Also, perform sterilization surgeries on men and women.
Craft hand-thrown canisters that release a lingering cloud of caustic tox gas.

Manufacture an advanced artificial kidney. Using a series of nanofilters, it can rapidly remove a vast range of toxins from the blood, making it effective against environmental toxins, venoms, and injected poisons.
Construct growth vats which can gestate an embryo or accelerate a child's growth.
Extract bioferrite directly from captured entities. Use it to craft weapons and apparel at a crafting spot or bioferrite shaper.
Build bioferrite harvesters that automatically extract bioferrite from captured entities. Produces more bioferrite than manual extraction.
Shape and re-form bioferrite into useful tools, weapons, flooring, and more.
Create advanced weapons that use bioferrite as a fuel source.
Build power generators that burn bioferrite as a fuel.
Craft special void sculptures from bioferrite to enhance the quality of psychic rituals.
Restructure archotech shards into limited-use weapons that shock, manipulate, and destroy enemies using archotechnology.
Restructure archotech shards into limited-use weapons that twist living targets into terrifying creatures.
Build bioferrite-powered heaters that produce enough heat to warm an entire region.

Build shard-powered structures that generate a frenetic psychic field to make anyone nearby move and work faster. However, the unstable emotional energy creates a tendency towards violence, irritating anyone nearby.
Build shard-powered structures that stimulate those nearby to prevent fatigue. The device will irritate anyone nearby.
Build holding platforms and inhibitors to better contain entities.
Build a generator that draws electricity from contained entities. This process aggravates entities, making them harder to contain.
Build bioferrite-based flare packs that reveal invisible creatures and light up an area.
Build a device that can detect invisible creatures.
Build a psychic ritual spot and perform psychic rituals. Use the void provocation ritual to discover new entities.
Perform a psychic ritual which will draw a herd of animals.
Perform a psychic ritual which will draw a horde of animated corpses. While hostile, the corpses won't attack your colony directly. They can be captured for study.

Perform a psychic ritual that causes a target to age rapidly. The ritual invoker will become younger in the process. The target will suffer brain damage as a result, which may be lethal for elderly targets.
Perform a psychic ritual which deadens a target's psychic sensitivity and temporarily boosts the ritual invoker's psychic sensitivity. The target will suffer brain damage as a side-effect.
Perform a psychic ritual that abducts a random hostile person from anywhere in the world, putting them in a short-term coma for capture.
Perform a psychic ritual which provokes fleshbeasts to emerge from the ground near enemies, attacking anyone nearby.
Perform advanced psychic rituals.
Perform a psychic ritual which causes underground fleshbeasts to open up a massive hole in the ground. The hole leads down to a fleshbeast-infested cavern which can be explored for resources.
Perform a psychic ritual which grants death refusal to an individual, allowing them to self-resurrect once after dying.
Perform a psychic ritual that drains experience from a victim and gives it to the invoker. The process will dull the target's mind, weakening their skills and causing brain damage.
Perform a psychic ritual that makes everyone in the region happier but reduces their desire to work.
Perform a psychic ritual that makes everyone in the region work faster but become more irritable.
Perform a psychic ritual which causes blood-like psychofluid to fall from the sky. Anyone caught outside will soon be driven into a berserk rage.

Perform a psychic ritual which erases much of a person's episodic memories. Traumatic events will be forgotten. Resistant prisoners will become easier to recruit. Allows recruiting unwaveringly loyal prisoners.
Build a serum lab to synthesize high-tech serums. Serums harness archotechnological power to bestow a temporary effect on the user.
Synthesize metalblood serums that make the user more resistant to damage.
Synthesize a serum that stabilizes a person's mood, preventing mental breaks.
Synthesize a serum which temporarily increases the user's strength and speed, and allows them to recover from injuries faster. However, it reduces their mood.
Perform a surgery that lobotomizes a person, making them happier while rendering them incapable of intellectual and skilled labor.

Perform a surgery that infuses a living person with an archotech shard, transforming them into a terrifying ghoul. Ghouls are strong melee combatants but are incapable of doing work. Ghouls will go mad if they are not fed enough raw meat.

Manufacture a number of barbed bioferrite spikes that can be surgically attached to a ghoul. They drastically increase a ghoul's melee damage but also limit its range of motion, slowing it down.

Due to the extremely painful nature of the prosthetic, only ghouls can tolerate this enhancement.
Synthesize a serum that can bring dead ghouls back to life.
Craft devices that produce clouds of microscopic archites. The archites can reanimate corpses to produce deadly shamblers that will only attack your enemies.
Modify a revenant spine so that it can be implanted in a human, allowing them to become temporarily invisible.
Build a wearable pack that allows the user to deploy a battery-powered turret.
Build a heavily reinforced door. It is slow to open and requires power, but is very strong. It's a good choice if you want to keep something dangerous out - or in.
Place zones where your colonists can go fishing.
Refine chemfuel into astrofuel and store it in pressurized tanks. Unlocks the construction of the gravjumper engine, allowing the first steps into gravship travel.
Unlock gravship engines capable of lifting a colony into orbit. Allows construction of control terminals for new gravship systems such as gravtech research and maintenance.
Unlock gravhulks, massive gravships capable of supporting entire colonies. Also allows crafting of gravlite panels, essential ultratech material for advanced gravship construction.
Build vac barriers to protect against depressurization, and orbital scanners to detect locations in space.
Build heavy bridges that support heavy buildings. You can use this to build whole colonies on the water.
Craft sweeping gamma-ray lasers that pierce heavy armor and ignite exposed targets.

Build a shuttle which can be used for long distance travel or to reach orbit. This requires a shuttle engine which can be bought from orbital traders, salvaged from other shuttles, or obtained through quests.
Build traps and wearable packs that release hunter drones. These explosive drones pursue hostiles and detonate when within range.
Build a composter for turning sewage into fertilizer for increasing the fertility of diggable terrain.
Build standard and hidden pipes that connect plumbing fixtures.

Build log boilers that produce 2000 heating units for piped radiators and hot water tanks, and hot water tanks that store hot running water for showers and baths. A log boiler heats the room and adjacent baths, and requires wood logs for fuel.
Build thermostats, radiators, large radiators and heated towel rails that distribute and control heat through a piped water system.

Build water heaters for hot water tanks and radiators: chemfuel boilers (2000 heating units), electric boilers with a manual power setting, and geothermal water heaters (7000 heating units). Boilers can be controlled by thermostats.

Build a power shower that heats water on demand without a hot water tank and cleans twice as fast.\n90L per wash

Build a washing machine that washes clothes so well that you can't even tell someone died wearing it!

Manufacture an advanced artificial bladder. A chemical recycling system breaks down waste products from the body into molecules which are recycled with the remainder released as gas, the downside of this being that it gives the user gas.

Unlocks a range of more complex artisanal processes. This research project will unlock all recipes that require another artisanal product to craft, such as for example sour cream, requiring milk and vinegar.
Unlocks techniques for infusing flavors into other artisan crafts, allowing colonists to craft infused oils, vinegars, and other enhanced artisanal products.
The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control Apex-tier mechanoids. You can get chips by using a mechanitor to summon a Three Lords threat. They can also be summoned separately.

Utilize advanced brewing techniques that allow distillation and fermenting of harder spirits with unique effects.

projects.ds: A condiment is a spice, sauce, or preparation that is added to food, either after or during cooking, to impart a specific flavor, to enhance the flavor, or to complement the dish. All condiments are created at the condiment prep table.

Soup is a primarily liquid food, generally served warm or hot, that is made by combining ingredients of meat or vegetables with stock, or water. Hot soups are additionally characterized by boiling solid ingredients in liquids in a pot until the flavors are extracted. This research also gives access to the electric pot necessary to cook soups.

Grilling is a form of cooking that involves dry heat applied to the surface of food, commonly from above, below or from the side. Grilling usually involves a significant amount of direct, radiant heat, and tends to be used for cooking meat and vegetables quickly. This research gives access to the grill.

Deep frying (also referred to as deep fat frying) is a cooking method in which food is submerged in hot fat, most commonly oil, as opposed to the shallow oil used in conventional frying done in a frying pan. This research gives access to the deep fryer.

Canning is a method of preserving food in which the food contents are processed and sealed in an airtight container (jars like Mason jars, and steel and tin cans). Canning provides a shelf life of several years. A freeze-dried canned product, such as canned dried lentils, could last as long as 30 years in an edible state. This research gives access to the canning machine.

Cheesemaking (or caseiculture) is the craft of making cheese. The production of cheese, like many other food preservation processes, allows the nutritional and economic value of milk to be preserved in concentrated form. Cheesemaking allows the production of the cheese with diverse flavors and consistencies. This research gives access to the cheese press.

Haute cuisine is the pinnacle of culinary artistry, emphasizing meticulous preparation, refined techniques, and exquisite presentation. It transforms the finest ingredients into visually stunning and harmoniously balanced dishes, elevating dining to an experience of sophistication. This research also unlocks the haute section, a specialized workstation for crafting these masterful creations.
Stew is a form of a very nourishing meal, cooked in bulk over fire. This research also gives access to the wood-fired pot necessary to cook stews.
Craft the pipe organs, an incredibly advanced and intricate stationary musical instrument.
Build noble decorations like royal rugs, mirrors, grand chairs, imperial slabs, candelabras, and more.
Construct the most grand, most beautiful stellic throne for your high ranking nobility.
Craft janissary armor, light powered armor that’s commonly used by imperial recon troops. Note that these also require advanced components.
Create imperial megaturrets: Kontarion, Onager and Palintone, as well as their ammunition.
Craft powerful imperial mortar shells, such as shrapnel, armor piercing and cluster.
Build advanced explosive traps with remote detonation mechanism.
Learn how to keep bees to produce honey from nearby plants. Honey can be used in creation of sweetrolls and mead.
Plant grapes which can then be used to create wine must and eventually, high quality wine.
Learn to plant various alchemical ingredients and combining them into different draughts at an alchemy lab.
Learn to construct various medieval structures, including cloth walls.
Learn to build various tools and devices to enhance the productivity of the workbenches.
Craft crude handheld gunpowder tubes that launch devastating shot at short range.
Adorn the colors of your faction and construct decorative banners and heraldic rugs.
Unlock the capability to utilize and manage fire for various purposes. Unlocks firefighting job.
Learn to grow various staple crops. Unlocks growing job.
Acquire the knowledge to manage, tame, and accommodate animals. Unlocks handing job, as well as animal taming and slaughtering.
Develop methods to extract resources from the earth using force. Unlocks mining job.
Learn the absolute basic techniques of building and structural design. Unlocks the ability to build walls and roofs.
Introduce basic furniture crafting for improved living conditions.
Learn to craft traditional tribal attire for various purposes.
Establish methods for effective hunting and resource processing. Unlocks hunting job and allows you to craft throwspikes.
Introduce basic weaponry for defense against enemies: simple clubs, shivs, axes, maces and spears from wood, bone and stone.
Craft short bows, slings and throwing shards for striking from a distance.
Unlock the ability to conduct research, as well as develop ideological thoughts. Unlocks intellectual job.

Build a a fast, insectlike combat mechanoid armed with a vicious sharp blade on its head. It isn't as dangerous as other close-ranged mechanoids, such as scythers, but they usually appear in greater numbers.

Build a humanoid mechanoid equipped with a powerful tesla gun, a fearsome energy weapon designed to unleash a cascade of electromagnetic energy upon its targets. Capable of generating a burst of EMP energy that can stun and disable mechanoids with a single shot. At the same time, it unleashes a searing bolt of electrical energy that can burn through organic targets, leaving them smoldering and vulnerable.

Build a heavy combat mechanoid with a humanoid body plan. They are faster than centipedes, and are usually armed with heavy mechanoid weapons or needle guns.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Faster than a centipede, but weaker due to their weaker weapons. If built by the player, it will have a "Swap weapon" ability to choose between the charge blaster and the Needle gun. If toggled to not spawn via mod options, they will get replaced by a Centipede Gunner.

Build a particularly dangerous tank-shaped mechanoid. Armed with a Siegebreaker Cannon that fires explosive shells, they can detect a hostile presence from hundreds of meters away, acting as unrelenting siege weapons that can obliterate even the strongest defense. Their movement is incredibly slow, and their cannon takes a very long time to recharge, but they should be treated as priority targets in most cases.

Research technology that harnesses advanced energy manipulation techniques to create focused and directed energy beams that can be transmitted across vast distances, and enable the summoning of the formidable Infernus mechanoid.

A communication method that operates on a framework of relay stations positioned across the system. These relay stations, known as "voidlinks," use subspace communication technology to transmit messages at near-light speed, allowing for rapid communication across sub-stellar distances. Enables the summoning of the War Empress mechanoid.

A cutting-edge communication system that leverages the principles of quantum mechanics to transmit information using more than just binary states of 0s and 1s. The use of these qubits allows for the transmission of complex data, instructions, or commands in a highly efficient and secure manner. Enables the summoning of the Apoptosis mechanoid.

A technology that involves the use of advanced cryptographic algorithms to achieve perfect synchronization and coordination between multiple mechanoid units or systems. It allows for seamless communication, information exchange, and coordination.

Soybean fermentation is the process by which soybeans are submitted to a chemical breakdown by bacteria, yeasts, or other microorganisms, transforming into new products. This research gives access to the soy sauce fermenter.
Build luxury furniture focused strongly on aesthetics and beauty over practicality, usually only seen in the houses of the wealthy elite. Including poster beds, royal chairs, tables and armchairs.
Learn to build furniture of the modern day that is focused on practicality over beauty, such as roulette tables, wardrobes, dart boards, punching bags and ergonomic beds.
Learn to build trash bins, small containers that hold trash until it can be hauled away.

Create beautiful ways to display artifacts and important colony goods.
Sculpt accurate character-shaped sculptures, inscribed with artistic illustrations.
Create massive monuments, centerpieces of your colony, to commemorate those who passed and give inspiration to those still struggling.
Learn how to create beautiful rugs to decorate your colony.
Construct beautiful walls covered in wallpaper of your desired colour.
Adapt advanced display techniques to showcase three-dimensional models around your colony.
Build automated transport belts for efficiently transporting materials around the colony.
Build automated transport belts that can tunnel underground and back up for more complex logistics networks, plus factory boosters and heatsinks that link with nearby factory machines.
Learn to construct artificial ecosystems, highly advanced terraria which vastly improve upon hydroponics.
Assemble schematics for a device which can automatically water fields, increasing the speed at which crops grow.
Build a primitive humanoid figure capable of scaring off small animals.

The ultimate power generation method, nuclear power is as sufficient as it is deadly.

Adapt spacecraft weaponry as part of your defensive systems.
Develop EMP traps and tesla blasters capable of stunning mechanoids.
Build ultratech shield generators that project energy fields to repel projectiles.
Build advanced furniture usually only seen in advanced colonies and glitterworld buildings.
Build advanced electronics usually only seen in advanced colonies and glitterworld buildings.

Unlock smaller variants of workbenches designed for gravships. Compact enough to fit into tight quarters without sacrificing essential functions.
Harvest and store oxygen for use on gravships. Unlocks construction of vacsuits and other survival gear needed to operate in vacuum.
Construct astrofuel synthesizers that automatically convert chemfuel into astrofuel for gravship use.
Construct gravship solar panelling, gravcore power cells, and astrofuel generators to supply energy for gravship systems.
Harvest structural heat generated during gravship launches and dissipate it safely. Excess heat can be converted into usable power. Heatsink capacity and power output is increased.
Build gravship-exclusive furniture such as bunk beds, lockers, and medbay beds to keep crew comfortable and functional in long voyages.
Build doors that use advanced technology to provide strong protection.

Reinforce the gravship by constructing gravship armor and subarmor, new compact turrets and gravmines, as well as gravship shield generators, making it much more resistant to enemy fire.
Construct various buildings and apparel that improve the comfort and security of living in harsh vacuum of space.
Research the helixien gas and it's ability to act as a combustible fuel.
Build market stalls: a counter under an awning where visiting merchants set up their wares, or where you sell your own goods to shoppers.
Vegetable milk extraction allows the colonists to extract milk from rice, oats, almonds, coconuts and soybeans.

Build automated machines that craft finished goods, such as the automated loom and automated ammunition press. They can only output goods of normal quality.
Build conveyor-fed factories that process goods in bulk: the conveyor oven, conveyor crematorium, automated distillery, drug granulator and neutroamine synthesizer.

Develop a method for producing antibiotics that boost the immune system after infections take hold.
Manufacture flake and other cheap, powerful and exceptionally addictive drugs.

Craft heavy pulse-charged blasters that focus sustained bursts through advanced targeting systems.

projects.ds: Construct a station capable of researching technologies.
Construct a bench capable of sculpting art.
Build a large truck meant to deliver troops and supplies away from the base. It can move well in rough terrain, but the fuel efficiency is low, and passengers in the back will lack protection.

Build a small tank with light armor. It's very cheap and easy to assemble, but very loud and vulnerable in the rear. They aren't very fast or accurate and use a lot of fuel, and are best used in short-range engagements.

Build improvised armed vehicles: a light flame tank with fireproof plating and chemfuel tanks that burns enemies and fortifications, and a farm tractor repurposed to carry a rack of explosive rockets. Neither is fuel-efficient on the world map.

Build fast aircraft: a small helicopter that carries more cargo than an off-roader but needs a landing pad, and a fighter plane with minimal cargo capacity, made to engage other aircraft. Aircraft are very easy to notice.

Build vehicles that carry many people: minivans and vans with high passenger space, and, with the right mods, passenger buses and light utility jeeps. They do best on paved roads and struggle in hills, snow and winter.

Build motorbikes for a single rider: dirt bikes that cross any terrain but carry no cargo, and motorcycles that carry a little cargo and are fuel-efficient on the world map. Both struggle in snow and winter.

Build motorized boats: small boats with good cargo capacity but high fuel use, and larger vessels with high cargo capacity, good fuel efficiency and low visibility. Boats have trouble with winter and river currents.

Build automobiles: makeshift cars that are fast but carry only a couple of people, and all-purpose passenger cars with good passenger and cargo capacity and high fuel efficiency. Cars do best on smooth roads.

Build armored vehicles for troops: lightly armored cars that provide mobile fire support, and armored personnel carriers with hardened armor, good cargo capacity and all-terrain support. Both are weaker in the rear.

Build reusable pods: rocket pods fitted with thrusters that move much faster than transport pods, and heavily armored siege pods with a siege gun on top that work as deployable bunkers. Both use a lot of fuel.

Gestate the frostivus, tinker and vassal support mechanoids.
Build mech repair stations, stasis chambers, gestator amplifiers and purifier stations.
Manufacture a plasma whip inspired by the Lasher mechanoid's weapon. It can damage and stun multiple targets at once, making it useful for holding back enemies at close range.
Build a powered station that repairs large mechanoids. The mechanoid enters the station to undergo repairs.
Gestate the celerus, dominus and terminus commander mechanoids.
Craft the skipblade, dominion psy-spear and severing blade from commander mechanoid technology.
Gestate the javelin and siren mechanoids.
Gestate the aegis, dynamo, mantis and maul heavy mechanoids.
Gestate the gazer, ravager and ingestor ultra-heavy mechanoids.
Manufacture a reinforced gamma-ray emitter that produces a dense, destructive energy ball which discharges into nearby targets and ignites its surroundings.
Manufacture a mechmancer suit and matching helmet, power-assisted mechanitor armor that greatly expands bandwidth while providing serious protection.
Manufacture a mechmancer pack, an advanced bandwidth-expansion utility pack that can deploy independent satellite mechanoids.
Build devices that boost the efficiency, protection and targeting of nearby friendly mechs.
Build the mech disruptor and persistent mech booster.
Manufacture a heavy power armor helmet packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mech master helmet drastically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, while being as protective as a marine helmet.
Build a remote mech disruption device. Any enemy mechanoids in its effect radius will have reduced agility, movement and targeting skill.

Manufacture a backpack containing a voidlink relay to access the vast amounts of data present on this system's mechanoid voidlink network. It can vastly increase a mechanitor's maximum total bandwidth.
Summon the apoptosis and infernus mechanoids.
Assemble battle and turret drones.
Assemble hauler, miner and broadcaster drones.
Manufacture headsets, packs and implants that extend a mechanitor's bandwidth, control groups and gestation speed.
Manufacture array headsets, bandwidth packs, band nodes and high control sublinks.
Manufacture integrator headsets and mechcommander helmets.
Build a remote energy and computation enhancement device. Any friendly mechanoids in its effect radius will move and work faster.
Manufacture mechlink upgrades that let a mechanitor repair and shield mechs from a distance.
Manufacture the mechlord suit and repair probe.
Gestate ultra-tier combat mechanoids such as the legionary, tesseron and war queen.
Build an extinguisher drone trap that launches a firefoam drone when it detects nearby flames.
Build a wearable pack that deploys a hunter drone.
Gestate heavy and ultra-heavy combat mechanoids.
Gestate medium combat mechanoids that fight up close.
Gestate mechanoids built for mining, drilling and hauling.
Gestate advanced worker mechanoids for crafting and medical care.
Gestate medium combat mechanoids that fight from range.
Gestate mechanoids that care for children, serve customers and tend to the colony's daily needs.

Manufacture simple mechanical replacements for lost limbs, joints and senses. Covers, depending on your mods: prosthetic leg, cochlear implant, artificial nose, golden eye, hydraulic jaw, light receptor, prosthetic finger, prosthetic foot, prosthetic hand, prosthetic toe, replacement spine and programmable security clearance microchip.
Wire small devices directly into the brain to change how it feels. Covers, depending on your mods: joywire and mindscrew.
Build blades and spikes small enough to implant in the body. Covers, depending on your mods: elbow blade, knee spike and scyther blade.
Manufacture replacement arms built for a single job. Covers, depending on your mods: drill arm and field hand.
Graft bioferrite prosthetics that only a ghoul can tolerate. Covers, depending on your mods: adrenal heart, corrosive heart, ghoul plating, metalblood heart and blood warmer.

Manufacture advanced artificial limbs, sense organs and spines with a biogel nerve-link. Covers, depending on your mods: bionic leg, bionic ear, bionic eye, bionic jaw, bionic spine, bionic tongue, bionic finger, bionic foot, bionic hand, bionic toe, bionic nose, silent jaw, bionic locomotive spine, bionic strider leg, pyrinth arm, pyrinth eye and pyrinth leg.
Install implants that help colonists fly and fight aboard gravships. Covers, depending on your mods: personal grav engine, gunnery assistant and pilot assistant.
Reshape the body for beauty, attraction and strength. Covers, depending on your mods: aesthetic shaper, love enhancer and strength enhancer.
Install implants that speed up healing and stop bleeding. Covers, depending on your mods: healing enhancer, cellcycle accelerator, cryptocoagulator and synthmarrow.
Install implants that analyze and adjust the body chemistry. Covers, depending on your mods: immunoenhancer, bio-tuner, detoxifier enhancer and gourmand tongue.
Install implants that boost the brain. Covers, depending on your mods: learning assistant, royal eye, hacking port, memory databank, wired reflexes and security clearance brain interface.
Implant glands that harden the skin. Covers, depending on your mods: armorskin gland, stoneskin gland, jotunnskin gland and vacskin gland.
Replace the stomach with organs that process food in unusual ways. Covers, depending on your mods: nuclear stomach and sterilizing stomach.
Install implants that change how much sleep a person needs. Covers, depending on your mods: circadian half-cycler and circadian refresher.
Grow synthetic replacements for internal organs and muscle. Covers, depending on your mods: synthetic stomach, synthetic kidney, synthetic liver, synthetic lung, muscle stimulator and AI chip.
Install an implant that speeds up a mechanitor's mech gestation. Covers, depending on your mods: mech gestation processor.

Build the basics of hygiene without plumbing: pit latrines, burn pits for fecal sludge, water wells for manual collection, water tubs for washing and drinking, bath mats, stall doors, and litter boxes, troughs and bowls for animals.

Supply plumbed fixtures with water: wind pumps, groundwater and surface water intakes, water butts, tanks and towers, and valves that open or close connections between pipes. Stored water must be drained if it becomes contaminated.
Build basic plumbed fixtures: basins for washing hands after using the toilet, bathtubs for a comfortable, leisurely wash, and sewage outlets where sewage pools and slowly cleans up.
Build showers and shower stalls that use water supplied by water towers. They can be heated via plumbed hot water tanks and do not require a sewage outlet.\n65L per wash
Build kitchen sinks that increase room cleanliness and water fountains used for drinking and washing.
Build large stores of water for plumbed fixtures: huge water towers and, with DBH Expanded, large water tanks and large hot water tanks. Stored water must be drained if it becomes contaminated.
Build gas coolers for cold rooms using helixien gas.
Build gas heaters for warm rooms using helixien gas.
Build chemfuel heaters for warm rooms without relying on the power grid.
Craft simple garments from leaves and plant fibers.

Engineered tissues and miniature control systems reproduce internal organ functions with performance beyond basic prostheses.

Manufacture an advanced artificial heart. It has synthetic muscle fibers for a realistic heartbeat, plus a high-flow pump for rapid circulation during high stress. It is better than a biological heart in almost every way.
Manufacture a heart prosthesis. It contains an electric motor that pumps blood smoothly around the body. Users often report feeling tired, but it's better than the alternative.
